title: 第六章　市场的属性

zh: 第六章　市场的属性
en: 6 The Properties of Markets

zh: 在二十世纪最后二十五年，横跨北大西洋世界及其他地区，一种新的治理模式确立起来，它在对“经济”的治理之外兴起，与之并存，并很快在重要性上与之匹敌。人们发现自己的生活通过一种新颖而更强大的抽象得到管理，这种观念将为以未来为代价的生活提供新的托词。这种抽象被称为“市场”。
en: In the last quarter of the twentieth century, across the North Atlantic world and beyond, a new mode of government took hold, emerging alongside the government of ‘the economy’ and soon rivalling it in importance. People found their lives managed through a novel and more powerful abstraction, an idea that was to provide a new alibi for living at the expense of the future. The abstraction was called ‘the market’.

zh: 当然，市场交换的观念并不新鲜。古典政治经济学家曾大量论述“商业社会”。然而，两项变化把市场转变为一种更有效的治理机制。第一项我们已注意到。十九世纪末的帝国时代，交换行为开始被理解为一种数学装置。正如我们在

所见，货币市场的突然增长促成了经济学新科学的诞生。股市和其他交易所产生了“高度人为的过程”，标准化商品在其中以即时可知的价格交易。经济学家以这些场所为范例，首次基于边际效用原则制定了供求法则。人的劳动、商品或货币的价值，如今据说不是由其内在品质、而仅仅由其价格决定。定价是一个自动过程，供给和需求的微小增量在那里达到均衡点。所谓“新古典”经济学的信条被普遍接受花了一些时间。但在这种观点的信奉者中间，市场可以被视为一台有效决定资源和回报分配的机器。
en: The idea of market exchange, of course, was nothing new. The classical political economists had written extensively on the topic of ‘commercial society’. However, two changes transformed the market into a more effective mechanism of government. The first of these we have already noted. Towards the end of the nineteenth century, in the age of empire, the act of exchange came to be understood as a mathematical device. As we saw in

, the sudden growth of money markets helped create the new science of economics. Stock markets and other exchanges produced ‘highly artificial processes’, where a standardised good was traded at instantly knowable prices. Taking such sites as exemplary, economists formulated the laws of supply and demand, based for the first time on the principle of marginal utility. The value of human labour, goods, or money was now said to be determined not by their intrinsic qualities, but simply by their price. Pricing was an automatic process, in which small increments of supply and demand reached a point of equilibrium. It took some time before the tenets of what became known as ‘neoclassical’ economics were generally accepted. But, among the adherents of this view, the market could be considered a machine that efficiently determined the allocation of resources and rewards.

zh: 第二项变化发生在一个世纪之后。从 1970 年代后期起，这些“人为过程”开始被视为某种大得多的东西：一种治理共同世界关系的普遍机制。这类机制的增殖如今以单数形式被称为“市场”。这一第二项变化由一个组织良好的政治运动赋予力量。该运动被称为新自由主义，它把自己的项目界定为削减国家的作用，让市场的底层法则自由运作。然而在实践中，该运动帮助生产了市场作为一般抽象的产物。
en: A second change occurred a century later. From the late 1970s, these ‘artificial processes’ came to be seen as something much more: a general mechanism for the government of relations in the common world. The proliferation of such mechanisms was now referred to in the singular, as simply ‘the market’. This second change was given force by a well-organised political movement. Known as neoliberalism, the movement defined its project as curtailing the role of the state to allow free operation to the underlying laws of the market. In practice, however, the movement helped to produce the market as a general abstraction.

zh: 市场作为治理性抽象的出现，是一个与上一章所探讨的、早一代人的经济出现相平行的过程。在这两个案例中，先前被理解为一组多样过程的东西，都被转变成某种自身存在的对象。事实上，人们可以认为，“经济”和“市场”最初是并排出现的，作为捕捉集体生活应据以被治理之整体的相互竞争概念。在两次世界大战之间，强调政府在监管和规划经济关系中作用的经济学家开始把这些通过新统计知识形式揭示出来的关系称为“经济”。同一时期，政府计划和监管的反对者——正如我们先前在接过马克斯·韦伯工作的人中所见——主张，统计知识永远无法准确衡量经济关系的复杂性。作为替代，他们提出，个体经济行动者所拥有的分散知识——往往是默会知识——，通过市场交换转化为他们买卖的价格。从整体来看，价格作为一个知识体系运作，类似于政府关于经济的统计知识，却比后者更优越。
这类论点使人们有可能把“市场”想象为经济的二重身，模仿其自称构成自身对象的说法。二十世纪中叶战争时期和凯恩斯主义经济计划的兴起，把这种竞争性观念推入背景。一代人之后，随着新自由主义运动从边缘出现并开始决定经济话语和政策的框架，市场走向前台。
en: The appearance of the market as a governing abstraction was a process that paralleled the emergence of the economy a generation earlier, as explored in the last chapter. In both cases, what was previously understood as a diverse set of processes was transformed into something like an object in itself. One could argue, in fact, that, initially, ‘the economy’ and ‘the market’ emerged side by side, as rival concepts for capturing the totality through which collective life should be governed. In the interwar years, economists who emphasised the role of government in the regulation and planning of economic relations began to refer to those relations, revealed through new forms of statistical knowledge, as ‘the economy’. In the same period, opponents of government planning and regulation, as we saw earlier among those who took up the work of Max Weber, argued that statistical knowledge could never accurately measure the complexity of economic relations. As an alternative, they proposed that the dispersed, often tacit knowledge of individual economic actors is translated by market exchange into the prices at which they buy and sell. Taken as a whole, prices operate as a knowledge system, analogous but superior to the government’s statistical knowledge of the economy.

Such arguments made it possible to imagine ‘the market’ as a double or doppelganger of the economy, mimicking its claims to form an object in itself. The ascendancy of wartime and Keynesian economic planning in the middle decades of the twentieth century pushed this rival conception into the background. A generation later, as the neoliberal movement emerged from the margins and began to determine the framework of economic discourse and policy, the market came to the forefront.

zh: 新古典经济学的批评者常常指责它错误再现。经济学家把社会生活的复杂性简化为理性行动者计算的结果：这些行动者回应以价格表达的激励，以使自身利益最大化。批评者
声称，这样一来，他们把任何关于行动主体如何构成、利益如何形成、激励如何管理或资源最初如何分配的论述都排除在画面之外。这种批评很有力，但也有一个明显弱点：它假定经济学的工作是为一个外在于自身的世界建模。
en: Critics of neoclassical economics often accuse it of misrepresentation. Economists reduce the complexities of social life to the outcomes of the calculations of rational agents responding to incentives, expressed as prices, in ways that maximise their interests. In doing so, the critics

claim, they leave out of the picture any account of how agencies are constituted, interests are formed, incentives are managed, or resources are initially distributed. This criticism has plenty of force, but also a clear weakness: it assumes that the work of economics is to model a world external to itself.

zh: 如果我们以不同方式看待经济学呢？假设它从技术政治世界内部运作，而不是从某个外部位置运作。假设它提供一套计算工具和其他技术装置，其力量不在于对外部现实的再现，而在于对组织技术实践——被理解为市场——的有用性。这就是经济化过程。
用唐纳德·麦肯齐的话说，产生市场价格的算法应被视为“一台引擎，而不是一台相机”。
新古典经济学的狭隘因此有其目的。它有助于执行米歇尔·卡隆所谓的“框定”操作，即“纠缠”和“解缠”的过程。

经济理论必须假定一个已经由买者、卖者和待交换商品或服务组成的世界。然而，除非世界被简化以创造买者、卖者和商品，否则交换无法发生。复杂的人类与非人类力量之间的依附能力和依赖关系必须被解缠，才能创造出像理性经济行动者或即时可得、可衡量的商品或服务这样简单的东西。如果不存在某些安排来排除某些依附、把许多成本或索取权排除在计算之外、使共同世界的大部分变得不可知，并否认对气候崩溃、物种灭绝和种族灭绝等灾难性后果的责任，市场交换就无法运作。同样，正如卡隆所示，如果没有某种产生重新纠缠的过程、逐步在行动者和商品之间创造依附，交易也无法进行。
en: What if we think of economics differently? Suppose it operates from within the technopolitical world, not from some place outside it. Suppose it provides a set of instruments of calculation and other technical devices, whose strength lies not in their representation of an external reality but in their usefulness for organising technical practices, understood as markets. This is the process of economisation.
In the words of Donald MacKenzie, the algorithms that produce market prices should be thought of as ‘an engine, not a camera’.
The narrowness of neoclassical economics then serves a purpose. It helps perform the operations that Michel Callon calls ‘framing’, or the process of ‘entangling’ and ‘disentangling’.

Economic theory must assume a world that already consists of buyers, sellers, and goods or services to be exchanged. However, an exchange cannot take place unless the world is simplified to create the buyer, the seller, and the good. Complex powers of attachment and relations of dependence among human and nonhuman forces must be disentangled to create something as simple as a rational economic agent, or an instantly available and measurable good or service. Market exchange would not work if arrangements were not in place to exclude some attachments, leave many costs or claims out of the calculation, render large parts of the common world unknowable, and deny responsibility for catastrophic consequences, such as climate collapse, species extinction, and genocide. Equally, as Callon shows, transactions could not take place if there were not some process of producing the re-entanglements that progressively create attachments between agents and goods.

zh: 经济分析并不描述这些排除和依附过程。相反，它帮助生产这些过程。它提供方法来区分在交换行为中什么可以计入、什么不能计入，哪些安排构成行动者、哪些不能，以及什么必须被计入、什么不应被计入。从这个角度看，不应根据经济学所再现——或未能再现——的现实来分析经济学，而应根据它帮助产生的安排、纠缠和排除来分析。
en: Economic analysis does not describe these processes of exclusion and attachment. Rather, it helps to produce them. It provides ways to distinguish what can count in the act of exchange from what cannot, which arrangements constitute agents and which do not, and what must be accounted for and what should not. From this perspective, economics should be analysed not in terms of the reality it represents – or fails to represent – but in terms of the arrangements, entanglements, and exclusions it helps to produce.

zh: 经济学把对其所建模的世界进行格式化的工作置于视野之外，这个世界似乎已经由买者、

卖者和商品组成。这样做时，它还做了另一件事。它把资产化工作——把未来生活形式转化为收入流、并使这种未来收入成为当下可以交易商品的过程——置于视野之外。这正是从未来榨取所依赖的过程。在这方面，“市场”观念执行了双重抽象。它抽象掉像卡隆这样的学者所描述的一切框定和（解）缠工作，复杂世界由此被简化为市场关系。但它也抽象掉一个时间过程，其中对未来的支配被误认为市场交易的非时间性、瞬时事件。市场是一种有效抽象，不仅因为它略去了或简化了生产行动者和商品世界的工作，而且因为它略去了生产一个可在当下被攫取的未来的工作。这样，市场交易看似瞬时的时间性——正如经济学工作中所框定的那样——促成了资本的托词。
en: Economics places out of sight the work that is performed to format the world it models, a world that seems already made up of buyers,

sellers, and commodities. In doing so, it does something else. It places out of sight the work of assetising, or the process of turning future forms of life into streams of revenue and making that future revenue into a commodity that can be traded in the present. This is the very process on which extraction from the future depends. In this respect, the idea of ‘the market’ performs a double abstraction. It abstracts from all the framing and (dis)entangling that scholars like Callon describe, in which complex worlds are simplified into market relations. But it also abstracts from a temporal process, in which the command of the future is mistaken for the atemporal, instantaneous event of a market transaction. The market is an effective abstraction, not only because it abstracts from, or simplifies, the work of producing a world of agents and commodities, but because it abstracts from the work of producing a future open to capture in the present. In this way, the seemingly instantaneous temporality of a market transaction, as framed in the work of economics, contributes to the alibi of capital.

zh: 经济学并不单独运作。它与其他技术、信息集合、安排和机构一起运作，具有不同的力量和资源。框定市场和资产化未来不仅通过经济学可能提供的分类或计算方法来进行。资产化和市场化所依赖的排除采取多种形式，并获得不同程度的效力和效果。另一组相互关联的安排是法律。
合同必须可计算，但也必须可执行。财产必须可转让，并可能被没收或收回。雇员必须被安排工作，也可能因雇主停工而被拒绝入厂，或被解雇。企业可能被接管或关闭。这类过程涉及技术、计算装置、控制方法和力量较量的混合。
en: Economics does not work alone. It operates together with other techniques, sets of information, arrangements, and agencies, with different strengths and resources. Enframing a market and assetising the future do not happen only by employing the methods of classification or calculation that economics may provide. The exclusions on which assetisation and marketisation depend take a variety of forms and acquire different degrees of force and effectiveness. Another, interrelated set of arrangements is the law.

Contracts must be calculable, but also enforceable. Property must be transferable and open to being forfeited or reclaimed. Employees must be put to work, or they may be locked out or fired. Businesses may be taken over or shut down. Such processes involve a mixture of technologies, calculative devices, methods of control, and trials of strength.

zh: 这些安排从哪里获得它们所需的强制形式？首先来自所谓的法治。市场依赖于一种政治形式，其中行动者之间以及跨时间的关系受财产和合同规则治理。这些是市场社会中独特的权力和义务技术，产生各种微型主权、规训制度和强制力量。
en: Where do these arrangements acquire the forms of compulsion they require? In the first place, from what is called the rule of law. Markets depend upon a form of politics in which relations among agents, and across time, are governed by rules of property and contract. These are among the distinctive technologies of power and obligation in market societies, generating a variety of micro-sovereignties, disciplinary regimes, and coercive forces.

zh: 财产安排往往相对稳定，但从不静止。财产形式不断增多。工程和技术科学产生新的对象、利益和行动者，例如把土地转化为可资本化资产的灌溉计划，允许把部分无线电频谱拍卖给电话公司的蜂窝
设备，从在线搜索中提取私人控制数据的算法，或者把大西洋鳕鱼转化为资产，使所有权主张可以附着其上并进而被交易的“海洋大经济化”。
财产的本质本身不断有待重新谈判，需要新的框定和解缠形式，以及新边疆的管理。
en: Property arrangements are often relatively stable, but they are never static. Forms of property proliferate. Engineering and technoscience develop new objects, interests, and agents, as for example with irrigation schemes that transform land into capitalisable assets, cellular

devices that allow parts of the radio spectrum to be auctioned to phone companies, algorithms that extract privately controlled data from online searching, or the ‘great economisation of the ocean’ that transforms the Atlantic cod into an asset to which claims of ownership can be attached and then traded.
The very nature of property is continually up for renegotiation, requiring new forms of enframing and disentangling, and the management of new frontiers.

zh: 但财产关系还有另一种限制。虽然无线电波或海洋可以被重新安排为新财产形式，从而转化为可销售资产并加以资本化，但还有其他场所，其中的财产关系已存在数十年甚至数代，却仍与市场规则保持距离。事实上，世界上大多数地区的多数人，其生活方式在许多方面受到保护，免受私有财产规则和资产化过程的影响。他们可能住在自己建造、但并未正式拥有地块的住房里，或耕种受保护免遭外部购买的农地，或生产主要供家庭消费的粮食。婚姻或继承安排可能起作用，确保土地、牲畜或其他商品不会因代际更替而落入市场。
en: But property relations have another kind of limit. While the airwaves or the oceans can be rearranged into new forms of property, and thus transformed into marketable assets and capitalised, there are other sites that have known property relations for decades or generations yet have kept the rules of the market at arm’s length. In fact, most people in most of the world live lives in many ways protected against the rules of private property and the process of assetisation. They may live in self-built housing on plots they do not formally own, or farm agricultural land that is protected against outside purchase, or produce food intended largely for household consumption. Marriage or inheritance arrangements may operate to ensure that land, livestock, or other goods are not lost to the market through the turnover of generations.

zh: 正式的财产规则有助于确定什么是合法和非法、什么是公共和私人。这类区分界定了市场，但也创造了在市场之外、或在区分所开辟的路径和空间中生存的方式。人们可能生产和交易非法商品，例如大麻或鸦片，合法的财产权通常无法适用于这些商品。他们的主要资源可能是城市街道的公共空间，例如在汽车拥堵的第三世界城市较富裕街区，人们在那里建立地盘，以非正式停车管理员身份谋生；或者政府办公室的走廊，在那里，获得合法许可和批准的困难使非正式“跑腿者”得以兴旺。
en: Formal rules of property help determine what is legal and illegal and what is public and private. Such distinctions define the market but also create ways to survive outside it or in the pathways and spaces that these distinctions open up. People may produce and trade illicit goods, such as hemp or opium, in which legal property rights are typically unavailable. Their main resource might be the public space of an urban street, as in the wealthier neighbourhoods of car-choked third-world cities, where people establish a territory and earn a living as informal parking attendants, or the corridors of a government office, where the difficulty of obtaining legal permits and approvals enables informal expediters to thrive.

zh: 这些非正式或非市场实践过去被视为某种残余，代表着抵抗经济化的飞地或占据某种中间空间的过渡区域。但正如非正式城市住房等例子所表明的，许多这类安排正在不断扩张，可能比正式财产安排扩张得更快。尽管它们被认为存在于市场之外、财产法之外，却绝非没有规则约束。即使相对较新，例如帕沙·查特吉所描述的加尔各答棚户区，它们也具有复杂的道德主张、社会权利和政治义务特征。正如朱莉娅·埃利亚查尔
所示，它们可以体现替代性的经济成功模式，并提供一些最有活力的经济生活形式。正如劳伦斯·梁对“多孔法律性”的论述所提示的，它们也可以渗透法律的路径，渗入受到更严密治理的财产和市场安排。
en: These kinds of informal or nonmarket practice used to be thought of as something residual, representing pockets of resistance to economisation or transitional regions occupying some intermediate space. But as examples such as informal urban housing suggest, many of these arrangements are constantly expanding, possibly faster than formal property arrangements. Although they are thought to exist outside the market, and outside the laws of property, they are far from lawless. Even when relatively new, such as the squatter settlements in Calcutta described by Partha Chatterjee, they are characterised by complex moral claims, social rights, and political obligations. As Julia Elyachar

shows, they can embody alternative modes of economic success and offer some of the most vibrant forms of economic life. As Lawrence Liang’s account of ‘porous legalities’ suggests, they also can penetrate the pathways of the law, seeping into the more closely governed arrangements of property and the market.

zh: 尽管这类安排具有多孔性，一种观念仍然存在：市场、实际上整个资本主义，有一个边界。这个边界被认为把市场与似乎存在于其界限之外的大片物质活动和资源区分开来。对西方以外的国家来说，边界观念提供了一种常见方式，不仅用来思考这些地方，还用来诊断其问题并设计适当补救方案。在新自由主义发展方案下，这类补救办法越来越流行。处理非西方发展的较早方式通常指经济的不同部门，例如传统部门与现代部门、农村部门与城市部门，或农业部门与工业部门。这些部门有移动的、有时重叠的边界。发展可以被规划为一系列转变，人口和资源从一个部门转移到另一个部门，或者市场的扩张在不同时刻改造经济的不同部分。由于变化随时间发生，非市场与市场、非资本主义与资本主义之间的差异，既是领域性转变，也同样是时间性转变。
en: Despite the porosity of such arrangements, the idea persists that the market, indeed capitalism in general, has a boundary. The boundary is thought to separate the market from the large areas of material activity and resources that seem to exist beyond its limit. For countries outside the West, the idea of a boundary provides a common way not just to think about these places but to diagnose their problems and design appropriate remedies. Under neoliberal development programmes, such remedies became increasingly popular. Older ways of approaching non-Western development typically referred to different sectors of the economy, such as the traditional and the modern, the rural and the urban, or the agrarian and the industrial. These sectors had moving and sometimes overlapping boundaries. Development could be planned as a series of transitions, in which people and resources were to be moved from one sector to another, or in which the expansion of the market transformed different parts of the economy at different moments. Since the changes occurred over time, the difference between the non-market and the market, or the non-capitalist and the capitalist, represented as much a temporal transition as a territorial one.

zh: 本章考察这种市场观念及其界限。它提出一种不同方式来理解市场边界，以及市场与非市场之间差异的地位。本章主张，市场与非市场、资本主义与非资本主义、资产化与非资产化之间的区分，不应被视为一条细线，而应被视为一个广阔地带，实际上是一个覆盖所谓资本主义全部领土的边疆地区。这个地区是政治斗争的场所，新的道德主张、关于正义的论点和权利形式在那里被锻造。当经济学帮助设计技术机制，把人和资产从市场之外越过一条线转移到市场之内时，它参与了这种政治。这类机制并不把事物移过一条固定的线，但它们确实重新安排了资产的控制和分配。这条线是这些机制所创造的东西，是重新分配和控制斗争的一部分。对经济学来说，这涉及一种不妨称之为错误再现的工作，因为外部必须根据其与市场的关系来构成——也就是说，根据其缺陷来构成，
作为非市场，作为某种有缺陷或死寂的东西。然而，称之为错误再现是不够的，因为它暗示从资本主义话语内部充分再现非市场是可能的。在实践中，非市场是一个无知领域，经济学的真理需要它才能运作。更有用的做法是考虑这种（错误）再现帮助组织了什么样的世界。
en: This chapter investigates this conception of the market and its limits. It proposes a different way of understanding the boundary of the market and the status of the difference between the market and the non-market. The chapter argues that the distinction between market and nonmarket, capitalist and non-capitalist, or assetised and non-assetised should be considered not as a thin line but as a broad terrain, in fact a frontier region that covers the entire territory of what is called capitalism. The region is the scene of political battles, in which new moral claims, arguments about justice, and forms of entitlement are forged. When economics helps to devise technical mechanisms to move people and assets across a line from outside the market to inside, it plays a part in this politics. Such mechanisms do not move things across a fixed line, but they do rearrange the control and distribution of assets. The line is something created by these mechanisms, as part of the battle over redistribution and control. For economics, this involves what might be called a work of misrepresentation, for the outside must be constituted in terms of its relation to the market – that is, in terms of its deficiencies,

as the non-market, as something defective or dead. Yet it is inadequate to call this a misrepresentation, for it implies the possibility of an adequate representation of the non-market from within a capitalist discourse. In practice, the non-market is a realm of ignorance that is required for the truths of economics to operate. It is more useful to consider what kind of world the (mis)representation helps to organise.

zh: 再现技术在这些安排中声称发挥双重作用。一方面，经济分析试图通过再现市场之外的世界来帮助重组技术政治生活，作为似乎把它带入市场之内、或使其资产化过程的一部分。另一方面，在描述这个非市场世界缺乏什么时，经济学往往把其缺陷诊断为缺乏再现技术。事物之所以卡在市场之外，是因为它们没有得到恰当再现——通过产权记录、价格、激励或其他指涉系统。然而，经济学所做的不是再现先前未知和未被再现的东西，而是重组再现的流通和控制。经济学的力量不一定在于让人们接受其（错误）再现；相反，在帮助构成市场与非市场、或资产化与非资产化之间表面边界的过程中，经济学促成了技术政治机制的工作，这些机制重组人们的生活方式、他们所能提出的政治主张，以及他们所能控制的资产。我认为，它的特殊作用在于格式化一种排除—纳入形式。
en: Technologies of representation claim a double role in these arrangements. One the one hand, economic analysis tries to help reorganise technopolitical life by representing a world outside the market, as part of the process of seeming to bring it inside, or assetise it. On the other, in describing what this non-market world lacks, economics tends to diagnose its defects as an absence of techniques of representation. Things are stuck outside the market because they are not properly represented – by property records, prices, incentives, or other systems of reference. What economics does, however, is not to represent what was previously unknown and unrepresented, but to reorganise the circulation and control of representations. The power of economics does not necessarily lie in getting people to adopt its (mis)representations; rather, in helping to constitute the apparent border between the market and the non-market, or the assetised and the non-assetised, economics contributes to the work of technopolitical mechanisms that reorganise how people live, the political claims they can make, and the assets they can control. Its particular role, I argue, is in formatting a form of exclusion-inclusion.

zh: 在新自由主义下，把发展视为从传统到现代转变的观点，让位于一个更简单的观念：“市场”被一条边界包围，边界之外是非资本主义、非市场世界。“发展”的任务是帮助把市场规则和资产化过程扩展到这些其他空间。这类提案的流行程度可以从赫尔南多·德·索托著作的成功来衡量；这位秘鲁企业家和经济学家有两本书，
（2000），它们成为一代人中最广泛引用的非西方经济发展研究。进行这些书中研究的秘鲁自由与民主研究所（ILD），一度被称为世界上影响力排名第二的智库。
这两本书都描述了存在于资本主义经济之外的财富和物质活动形式，诊断了把它们拒之门外的障碍的性质，并提出了把它们带入其中的资产化技术。自由与民主研究所在亚洲、非洲
和拉丁美洲的几个国家开展工作，设计程序，使被困于资本主义之外的东西能够被带入。这些机制的技术设计和实施，成为全球南方经济发展问题最流行的解决方案之一。
en: Under neoliberalism, the view of development as a transition from traditional to modern gave way to a more simple idea: the ‘market’ is surrounded by a boundary, outside which stands the non-capitalist, non-market world. The task of ‘development’ is to help extend the rules of the market and the process of assetisation into these other spaces. The popularity of such proposals can be gauged by the success of the work of Hernando de Soto, a Peruvian entrepreneur and economist, whose two books,

(2000), became the most widely cited studies of non-Western economic development in a generation. The Institute for Liberty and Democracy (ILD) in Peru, which carried out the research presented in these books, was at one point called the second most influential think tank in the world.

Both books described the forms of wealth and material activity that exist outside the capitalist economy, diagnosed the nature of the barrier that keeps them out, and proposed techniques of assetisation for bringing them in. The ILD worked in several countries in Asia, Africa,

and Latin America devising procedures to enable what is trapped outside capitalism to be brought in. The technical design and implementation of these mechanisms became one of the most popular solutions to the problem of economic development in the Global South.

zh: 一本非常了不起的书
en: A Very Great Book

zh: 德·索托在
中呈现了来自五个国家的研究结果，主张西方以外大多数国家未能仿效西方经济发展的主要原因，是其大量财富存在于正式经济之外。
这些财富被困在无法进入市场的形式中，因此无法被资产化或资本化以创造更多财富。这种财富被称为“死资本”，主要由土地和住房构成。非西方国家的多数人居住在所有权未在国家正式登记的住房中，因此缺乏对其财产的适当产权。德·索托说，这些人“处于全球经济之外，实际上处于市场经济之外，当然也处于资本主义经济之外”。
由于他们的土地和房屋在经济之外，他们无法将其用作抵押品来借款。他们的资产被锁定在住宅的物质形式中，无法转化为现金或信用。信用是“活”资本，可以积累、投资于商业项目，并转化为进一步收入。
en: Presenting the findings from research in five countries, de Soto argued in
that the main reason why most countries outside the West had failed to emulate the West’s economic development is that a large amount of their wealth lies outside the formal economy.

It is trapped in forms that cannot enter the market, and therefore cannot be assetised or capitalised to create further wealth. Described as ‘dead capital’, this wealth consists principally of land and housing. Most people in non-Western countries live in housing whose ownership is not formally registered with the state and thus lack proper title to their property. These people, said de Soto, ‘are outside the global economy, are in fact outside the market economy, are certainly outside the capitalist economy’.

Because their land and houses are outside the economy, they are unable to use them as collateral to borrow funds. Their assets are locked in the material form of their homes and cannot be transformed into cash or credit. Credit is ‘live’ capital that can be accumulated, invested in business ventures, and turned into further income.

zh: 根据德·索托的简单图式，活资本是通过设计再现技术创造的。对物质资产的再现把其价值转化为抽象形式，这些形式可以与其物理存在并行，过一种“无形的平行生活”。西方发明了创造这些无形形式的程序。西方个人可以解锁积累在实体财产中的资产，把物质财富转化为抽象资本。德·索托写道，用房屋作为贷款抵押品，是创办小企业的重要信用来源，提供了刺激经济增长的大量资金储备。他主张，成功的资本主义经济与世界其他地区之间最重要的差异，不在于它们拥有的财富，而在于财富的持有方式。世界其他地区以“有缺陷的形式”持有资产。缺乏产权及其所能促成的信用机制，是西方以外资本主义发展失败的主要原因。
en: Live capital, according to de Soto’s simple schema, is created by devising techniques of representation. Representations of material assets transform their value into abstract forms, which can live an ‘invisible, parallel life’ alongside their physical existence. The West has invented procedures to create these invisible forms. Individuals in the West can unlock the assets accumulated in physical property, transforming material wealth into abstract capital. Using a house as collateral for loans, wrote de Soto, is an important source of credit for launching small businesses, providing a large reserve of funds to stimulate economic growth. The most important difference between successful capitalist economies and the rest of the world lies not in the wealth they possess, he argued, but in how that wealth is held. The rest of the world holds its assets in ‘defective forms’. The absence of property title and the mechanism of credit it enables are the principal reason for the failure of capitalist development outside the West.

zh: 因此，解决全球贫困的办法，是在每个国家构建一个简单的再现装置，把死资本转化为活资产。这套机器由基于社区的项目组成，使人们能够登记财产所有权，并配有简化规则，允许把财产用作获得信用的抵押品。德·索托为这些提案组织了广泛支持。1994 年，他说服秘鲁政府在自由与民主研究所指导下启动一项产权登记计划，到 2002 年已向 120 万城市家庭发放正式产权。
随后许多其他国家聘请自由与民主研究所作为顾问，衡量本国未登记资产的规模，并设计将其推向市场的机制。
en: The solution to global poverty, it follows, is to construct in every country a simple apparatus of representation that will transform dead capital into live assets. The machinery consists of neighbourhood-based programmes to enable people to register ownership of their property and simplified rules for using the property as collateral for obtaining credit. De Soto organised wide support for these proposals. In 1994, he persuaded the government of Peru to launch a property titling programme under the ILD’s direction that by 2002 gave formal title to 1.2 million urban households.
Numerous other countries subsequently recruited the ILD as a consultant, to measure the extent of their countries’ untitled assets and devise mechanisms for moving them into the market.

zh: 德·索托的研究人员在埃及发现了最令人印象深刻的结果。他们估计，该国多达 92% 的住房以有缺陷的形式持有，代表 2,480 亿美元未充分利用的资产。在他们被最广泛引用的统计数据之一中，他们说这些死资本相当于现代埃及有记录以来全部外国直接投资总额的五十五倍以上，包括十九世纪修建苏伊士运河和二十世纪修建阿斯旺高坝的投资。
en: De Soto’s researchers found their most impressive results in Egypt. They estimated that as much as 92 per cent of the country’s housing was held in defective form, representing $248 billion in underused assets. In one of their most widely repeated statistics, they said that this dead capital represented more than fifty-five times the amount of all the direct foreign investment ever recorded in modern Egypt, including constructing the Suez Canal in the nineteenth century and building the Aswan High Dam in the twentieth.

zh: 这些项目具有吸引力的一些原因很容易理解。与其他发展问题诊断相比，德·索托对全球南方大多数人的资源和潜力作出了积极得多的描述。他较早的著作
是对秘鲁非正式经济部门的研究，主张不受监管的经济活动比过度监管的正式经济更有活力、更有效率。非正式部门的规模并非落后的标志，而是对正式经济活动过度官僚监管的理性回应。
表明，穷人不仅拥有创业技能，还拥有资产。未能充分开发这些资产，不是资产所有者的过错，因此不能归咎于穷人落后或传统的文化。这是正式部门的过错。德·索托主张，全球南方政府未能引入法律安排和金融机制，而正是这些未被注意的秘密促成了西方资本主义发展的成功。过去两个世纪现代产权的发展如此成功，以至于西方如今把这一装置视为理所当然，未能注意到它在西方以外大多数国家的缺失或不完整。
en: Some of the reasons for the appeal of these programmes are easy to see. Compared with other diagnoses of the problems of development, de Soto offered a much more positive account of the resources and potential of the majority of the people of the Global South. His earlier book,

, a study of the informal economic sector in Peru, argued that unregulated economic activity was more dynamic and more efficient than the over-regulated formal economy. The size of the informal sector was not an indication of backwardness but a rational response to excessive bureaucratic regulation of formal economic activities.

showed that the poor possessed not just entrepreneurial skills but also assets. The failure fully to develop these assets was not the fault of those who owned them and therefore could not be blamed on the backward or traditional culture of the poor. It was the fault of the formal sector. Governments in the Global South had failed to introduce the legal arrangements and financial mechanisms that were the unnoticed secret, de Soto argued, of the success of capitalist development in the West. The development of modern property rights during the previous two centuries was so successful that the West now takes this apparatus for granted and fails to notice its absence or incompleteness in most countries outside the West.

zh: 这些论点是对关于穷人的流行观念——认为他们因自身传统或文化而丧失能力——的有用替代。它们把穷人呈现为有能力的经济行动者，只需获得适当的技术装备，就能被带入市场。但德·索托论点的成功还有更多原因。它们提供了一种把穷人带入新自由主义论点和方案的方式。
en: These arguments were useful alternatives to popular ideas about the poor as people incapacitated by their own traditions or culture. They presented the poor as competent economic agents who needed to acquire only the proper technical equipment to be brought into the market. But the success of de Soto’s arguments was due to something more. They provided a way to bring the poor into the arguments and programmes of neoliberalism.

zh: 德·索托的提案在欧美新自由主义运动的政治机构和资金资源网络中发展、传播。该运动始于 1940 年代后期，最初是一个由企业资助者支持的保守经济学家和政治理论家小团体，其最有影响的思想家和组织者是奥地利出生的英国经济学家弗里德里希·哈耶克（我们曾在
遇到他）。此后几十年间，它成长为一个跨大西洋的智库、学院经济学家和政策制定者网络，由私人基金会和企业资助，在西方政府政策的形成中发挥了有影响力的作用。
en: De Soto’s proposals were developed and circulated within the network of political agencies and financial resources of the Euro-American neoliberal movement. From its beginnings in the late 1940s as a small association of conservative economists and political theorists supported by corporate benefactors, with the Austrian-born British economist Friedrich Hayek (whom we met in

) as their most influential thinker and organiser, the neoliberal movement grew over the following decades into a transatlantic network of think tanks, academic economists, and policy makers, funded by private foundations and corporations, that came to play an influential role in the shaping of government policy in the West.

zh: 1981 年，该运动的重要组织者和资助者安东尼·费舍尔在华盛顿特区附近建立了阿特拉斯经济研究基金会，以协调不断壮大的智库网络，并发起“一项协同努力”（哈耶克在一封支持信中的说法），“在世界各地建立类似的机构”。
哈耶克是在从秘鲁访问归来后写下这封信的，他在那里的一次会议上发表演讲，会议得到德国新自由主义者的资助，由赫尔南多·德·索托组织。
在哈耶克的敦促下，阿特拉斯基金会帮助德·索托建立了自由与民主研究所。阿特拉斯提供资金支持，并让德·索托及其合作者接受新自由主义经济思想及其为政治组织和倡导而发展出的技术的培训。
en: In 1981, Antony Fisher, a leading organiser and benefactor of the movement, established the Atlas Foundation for Economic Research, based near Washington, DC, to coordinate the growing network of think tanks and launch ‘a concerted effort’, in the words of a letter of support from Hayek, ‘to create similar institutes all over the world’.
Hayek wrote the letter after returning from a trip to Peru, where he spoke at a conference funded by German neoliberals and organised by Hernando de Soto.

At Hayek’s urging, the Atlas Foundation helped de Soto set up the ILD. Atlas provided financial support and trained de Soto and his collaborators in the economic ideas of neoliberalism and the techniques it had developed for political organisation and advocacy.

zh: 哈耶克和新自由主义运动的支持，使自由与民主研究所能够开展关于产权与穷人的研究——这些研究发表在
和
中——并在秘鲁推出第一批产权登记计划。这些计划对家庭贫困没有产生任何影响。本应弥补这一失败的其他好处同样虚幻。
然而，这些失败并未妨碍德·索托的成功。新自由主义作家和智库对他的著作给予好评，并通过广为人知的奖项表彰作者及其组织。
得到两位美国前总统的推荐，并获得
阿特拉斯基金会的一个奖项。
得到玛格丽特·撒切尔、珍妮·柯克帕特里克、托马斯·弗里德曼、弗朗西斯·福山和小威廉·F. 巴克利的推荐。
德·索托获得加图研究所的米尔顿·弗里德曼促进自由奖、
杂志的“战略方向指南针奖”、亚当·斯密奖、戈德华特奖以及其他几个奖项。
与此同时，他为穷人辩护的民粹主义语调，使其他人把他视为进步派。自由与民主研究所曾在网站上报告，即使偏左的英国刊物
也写道，德·索托的工作“使他跻身我们时代伟大进步知识分子的殿堂”。尽管该刊并没有这样写，德·索托还是设法宣称自己拥有远超新自由主义运动范围的支持者。
en: The support from Hayek and the neoliberal movement enabled the ILD to carry out its research into property rights and the poor, published in
and

, and to introduce its first property titling programmes in Peru. The programmes failed to have any effect on household poverty. Other benefits that were supposed to compensate for this failure were equally illusory.

Yet the failures did not prove an obstacle to de Soto’s success. Neoliberal writers and think tanks gave his books favourable reviews and recognised the author and his organisation with well-publicised awards.
carried endorsements from two former US presidents and received a prize from
the Atlas Foundation.
received endorsements from Margaret Thatcher, Jeane Kirkpatrick, Thomas Friedman, Francis Fukuyama, and William F. Buckley Jr.
De Soto received the Milton Friedman Prize for Advancing Liberty from the CATO Institute, the Compass Award for Strategic Direction from
, the Adam Smith Award, the Goldwater Award, and several other prizes.
At the same time, the populist tone of his arguments on behalf of the poor persuaded others to see him as a progressive. The ILD reported on its website that even the left-of-centre British journal

had written that de Soto’s work ‘has put him in the pantheon of great progressive intellectuals of our age’. Although this was not what the journal wrote, de Soto managed to claim supporters well beyond the limits of the neoliberal movement.

zh: 自由与民主研究所的工作还得益于将其与学院经济学联系起来的新自由主义网络。德·索托是实践者，不是学者，其研究是在智库而非大学中进行的。学院经济学家称赞他的工作，不是因为它对学术理论有所贡献，而是因为它实际展示了新古典经济学关于产权的真理。两位诺贝尔经济学奖得主罗纳德·科斯和米尔顿·弗里德曼为
撰写推荐。科斯称它“是一本非常了不起的书：有力而且完全令人信服”。
这种积极接受使其论点回流到学院经济学。德·索托的工作成为进一步大学研究的基础，并为经济学教材提供了素材；这些教材获得了弗里德曼以及道格拉斯·诺斯等经济学家的认可，其中弗里德曼再次给予了支持。
en: The ILD’s work also benefited from the neoliberal networks connecting it to academic economics. De Soto was a practitioner, not a scholar, producing research in a think tank rather than a university. Academic economists praised his work not as a contribution to academic theory but as a practical demonstration of neoclassical economic truths about property rights. Two Nobel laureates in economics, Ronald Coase and Milton Friedman, endorsed
. It is ‘a very great book’, wrote Coase: ‘Powerful and completely convincing’.

This positive reception enabled its arguments to flow back into academic economics. De Soto’s work became the basis for further university research and provided the subject matter for teaching materials in economics, endorsed by economists such as Friedman, again, and Douglass North.

zh: 尽管始终没有可靠证据表明他的想法行之有效，德·索托仍被描述为世界领先的发展专家之一。世界银行为秘鲁的自由与民主研究所产权登记计划提供资金，国际货币基金组织（IMF）宣传其理念，美国国际开发署为该智库的海外业务提供持续资助，国际劳工组织任命德·索托为全球化社会影响世界委员会成员。
2005 年 9 月，联合国开发计划署（UNDP）支持设立“贫困者法律赋权高级别委员会”，由德·索托和美国前国务卿马德琳·奥尔布赖特共同担任主席，目标是进一步为德·索托的政治纲领争取国际支持。
en: Despite the continuing absence of reliable evidence that his ideas worked, de Soto came to be described as one of the world’s leading experts on development. The World Bank funded the ILD titling programme in Peru, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) promoted its ideas, the United States Agency for International Development provided the think tank with continuous funding for its overseas operations, and the International Labor Organization appointed de Soto to its World Commission on the Social Dimension of Globalization.

In September 2005, the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) supported the establishing of the High Level Commission on the Legal Empowerment of the Poor, cochaired by de Soto and Madeleine Albright, the former US Secretary of State, with the goal of generating further international support for de Soto’s political programme.

zh: 的成功及其作者获得的认可，是德·索托在欧美
新自由主义运动帮助下通过公关努力制造出来的；这些使自由与民主研究所能够把自己的活动转化为一种财产形式。在向世界各国政府推销其产权计划时，德·索托的方法是绕过政府部委和地方发展机构，直接寻求国家元首的授权和支持。这使该研究所能够赢得政府独家咨询合同，这类合同的授予通常不按正常程序邀请其他咨询公司竞标。
en: The success of
and its author’s recognition, manufactured by de Soto’s public relations efforts with the help of the

Euro-American neoliberal movement, enabled the ILD to transform its own activities into a form of property. In marketing his property rights programme to governments around the world, de Soto’s method was to bypass government ministries and local development agencies and seek authorisation and support directly from a country’s head of state. This enabled the ILD to win exclusive government consulting contracts, typically awarded without the normal request for competitive bids from rival consulting firms.

zh: 例如在坦桑尼亚，德·索托在两人都被任命为全球化世界委员会成员时与该国总统会面。他利用这层关系获得一份未经招标的政府合同，尽管其他发展机构多年来一直在进行坦桑尼亚产权改革工作。自由与民主研究所为其独家合同辩解，理由是
所阐述的消除全球贫困方法独一无二，无法与现有计划结合。合同于 2004 年 11 月签署，其中要求坦桑尼亚政府“尊重自由与民主研究所对其提供的方法和技术所享有的知识产权”。
在解释为什么不允许其他发展机构参与竞标时，该研究所执行主任曼努埃尔·马约尔加说：
en: In Tanzania, for example, de Soto met the country’s president when both of them were appointed to the World Commission on Globalization. He used this connection to obtain a no-bid government contract, even though other development agencies had been working on the reform of Tanzanian property rights for many years. The ILD justified its exclusive contract on the grounds that its method of ending global poverty, explained in

, was unique and could not be combined with existing programmes. Signed in November 2004, the contract included a requirement that the Tanzanian government ‘respect ILD’s intellectual property rights over the methodology and techniques it provides’.
Explaining why other development agencies had not been allowed to bid for the contract, the executive director of the ILD, Manuel Mayorga, said that

zh: 在这一特定领域，是我们发明了轮子。理解正式法律部门与法外部门之间的差距，分析这两个平行部门如何运作，评估它们的问题……量化其经济影响，以及如何在一种法治之下将它们整合起来，创造一个现代、富有生产力的经济，这些正是自由与民主研究所率先开拓的领域。
en: in this particular area, we invented the wheel. Understanding the gap between the formal legal and extralegal sectors, analysing how these two parallel sectors operate, evaluating their problems . . . quantifying their economic effects, and how they might be integrated under one rule of law creating a modern, productive economy is the area that the ILD has pioneered.

zh: 因此，德·索托对市场知识的所有权主张——他对这种知识的资产化——成为资本积累的手段。与资产化的一贯情形一样，积累依赖于保护他自己的活动免受市场竞争。
en: Thus de Soto’s claim to ownership of knowledge about markets – his assetisation of that knowledge – became a means to the accumulation of capital. As always with assetisation, the accumulation depended on protecting his own activities from competition in the market.

zh: 在埃及，自由与民主研究所获得了贾迈勒·穆巴拉克的支持。他是埃及总统之子，也是埃及大型企业家中一个较年轻派系里最富有、最有权势的人物；该派系寻求加强私有财产的权力，以此撤销上一代人的社会改革。这个团体利用德·索托的论点帮助推动新的经济措施在议会通过，包括一部抵押贷款法、一项产权登记计划，以及小企业许可
新规。自由与民主研究所帮助起草这些法律，并开展公关活动以赢得政治支持。
与秘鲁一样，立法结果令人失望，但宣传活动即刻获得了成功。
杂志 2004 年 2 月发表一篇报道，预测该国新财产法将“戏剧性地把其经济转变为创造财富、分配财富的强劲引擎，引领数百万埃及人进入一个充满活力、日益民主的中产阶级”。该刊编辑写道，这个国家准备成为“与爱尔兰或香港匹敌的经济奇迹”，并补充说，这样一来，“埃及将对全球恐怖主义造成毁灭性打击”。
en: In Egypt, the ILD gained the backing of Gamal Mubarak, the son of the country’s president and the wealthiest and most powerful of a younger faction among large Egyptian entrepreneurs seeking to strengthen the powers of private property as a means of undoing an earlier generation of social reforms. This group used de Soto’s arguments to help push new economic measures through parliament, including a mortgage law, a property titling programme, and new rules
for licensing small businesses. The ILD helped draft the laws, along with a public relations campaign to win political support.
As in Peru, the outcome of the legislation was disappointing, but the publicity campaign was an immediate success.

published a story in February 2004 predicting that the country’s new property laws would ‘dramatically transform its economy into a wealth-creating, wealth-distributing dynamo that will lead millions of Egyptians into a vibrant, increasingly democratic middle class’. The country was poised to become ‘an economic miracle rivaling Ireland or Hong Kong’, the magazine’s editor wrote – adding that in doing so ‘Egypt will deal a devastating blow to global terrorism’.

zh: 既然埃及提供了德·索托所诊断缺陷最戏剧性的例子，而克服这些缺陷据说能带来经济奇迹，那么埃及的证据就值得考察。它能告诉我们德·索托论点的效力如何？尽管缺乏支持证据，这些观念实际上又是如何发挥作用的？
en: Since Egypt provided the most dramatic instance of the defects that de Soto diagnoses, and overcoming these defects was said to promise an economic miracle, it is worth looking at the evidence from Egypt. What can it tell us about the force of de Soto’s arguments? How are these ideas, despite the lack of evidence to support them, actually put to work?

zh: 市场之外
en: Outside the Market

zh: 关于埃及，首先要注意的是，自由与民主研究所提出的补救办法此前已被尝试过。一百五十年前，从 1850 年代开始，一系列法律引入现代私有财产制度，并配套建立自己的法院、财产登记处和强制执行机制。在多数情况下，这些程序承认奥斯曼法和地方法下现有的土地主张，但也使为购置和转让土地而抵押贷款成为可能，并为希望用财产作抵押的人提供了信贷来源。
正如我们在
和
所见，随之而来的是“尼罗河上的克朗代克”。
地方地主和欧洲债权人把贷款扩展到农村新的灌溉计划、土地开垦和蒸汽抽水设备，以及城市的住房和现代基础设施。到二十世纪之交，埃及股票市场——其最大持股集中在抵押贷款公司和房地产开发——已是世界上最活跃的市场之一。
en: The first thing to note about Egypt is that the remedy the ILD proposed had been tried before. One hundred and fifty years earlier, beginning in the 1850s, a series of laws introduced a modern system of private property, implemented with its own courts, property registers, and mechanisms of enforcement. In most cases, these procedures recognised existing claims to the land under Ottoman and local law, but they also made possible mortgages for the acquisition and transfer of land, and as a source of credit for those who wished to use their property as collateral.
As we saw in
and
, there followed a ‘Klondike on the Nile’.

Local landowners and European creditors extended loans for new irrigation schemes, land reclamation, and steam-powered pumping equipment in the countryside and for housing and modern infrastructure in the cities. By the turn of the twentieth century, the Egyptian stock market, whose largest shareholdings were in mortgage companies and property development, was one of the most active in the world.

zh: 结果是一场灾难。在埃及农村，小农面临迅速上涨的物价。税款大幅增加，用以支付统治家族地产的抵押贷款。1861 年和 1863—4 年的一场牛瘟杀死了该国大部分役畜，造成进一步困难。正如我们在
所见，这场瘟疫在 1870 年代和
1880 年代再次出现。为了获得贷款渡过这些危机，农民如今不得不抵押自己的土地。债权人得以利用新的止赎权力，夺取无力按时偿债者的资产。农民把执行止赎裁决的法院描述为“一台转移土地的机器”，把小农的土地转给富人。债权人不仅可以占有田地，还可以占有役畜和犁，并可以夺取或拆毁债务人的房屋。一份当时的报告告诉我们，债务水平使小农越来越难以架设水车，而主要粮食生产依赖水车。
en: The result was a disaster. In rural Egypt, small farmers faced rapidly rising prices. Tax payments increased sharply, to cover mortgage payments on the estates of the ruling family. A cattle plague in 1861 and 1863–4 killed most of the country’s draft animals, causing further difficulties. The plague returned, as we saw in
, in the 1870s and

1880s. To obtain loans to survive such crises, farmers now had to mortgage their own land. Creditors were able to use the new powers of foreclosure to seize the assets of those unable to keep up debt payments. Farmers described the courts that enforced foreclosure decisions as ‘a machine for transferring the land’ from small farmers to the wealthy. Creditors could take possession of not only the fields but also draught animals and ploughs and could seize or demolish debtors’ houses. The level of debt made it increasingly difficult for small farmers to erect waterwheels, a contemporary report tells us, on which the production of staple food depended.

zh: 个人所有者遭受的灾难，又借助同样的新财产和有担保贷款安排，在更大规模上重演。如先前各章所见，资产化、债务和止赎的机器为殖民占领提供了杠杆。1874 年，全球经济萧条开始，起因是欧洲投机性银行业的危机，包括向开罗的奥斯曼总督提供贷款，而他曾以大块棉花和甘蔗种植园作为抵押品。随着萧条导致棉花和糖价下跌，并让进一步信贷无从获得，政府无法推迟财政崩溃。1876 年，英法银行在开罗设立债务委员会，接管该国财政，并利用新法院占有总督的地产。当他抵制接管时，英法政府废黜了他，扶植其子上台。后者随后在与一场由下级军官和心怀不满的显贵领导的民众立宪运动的较量中逐渐失势。1882 年，英国人入侵该国，建立军事占领以铲除民众运动，并重新确立欧洲对财政和抵押财产的控制，包括大片总督地产。
en: The disaster suffered by individual owners was repeated on a larger scale, using the same new arrangements of property and secured loans. As we saw in earlier chapters, the machinery of assetisation, debt, and foreclosure provided the leverage for colonial occupation. In 1874 a global economic depression began, brought on by the crisis of speculative European banking, including loans to the Ottoman viceroy in Cairo, for which he had pledged his large cotton and sugar cane estates as collateral. As the depression caused the price of cotton and sugar to fall, and made further credit unavailable, the government was unable to postpone the financial collapse. In 1876, the British and French banking houses established a Debt Commission in Cairo, which took control of the country’s finances and used the new courts to take possession of the viceroy’s estates. When he resisted the takeover, the British and French governments had him deposed in favour of his son. The latter began to lose power to a popular constitutionalist movement, led by junior army officers and disaffected notables. In 1882 the British invaded the country, established a military occupation to eradicate the populist movement, and reasserted European control over finances and mortgaged property, including the extensive viceregal estates.

zh: 英国人试图巩固新的私有财产安排。他们进行土地测量，绘制全国每一英亩农地的所有权，并把信息记录在财产登记册中。测量和财产登记于 1907 年完成，比当时英国已知的任何同类工作都更全面。
与此同时，殖民当局被迫采取措施限制新财产规则的适用。1912 年，为了减缓村民失去土地和家园的速度，他们出台《五费丹法》。
该法以英国为处理印度西北部旁遮普类似问题而采取的措施为蓝本，防止
债权人夺取小农最后五英亩（费丹）土地、基本农具、两头役畜和他们的房屋。然而到 1920 年代，据估计尼罗河三角洲超过三分之一的农业人口已经失去土地。
第二次世界大战期间，政府出台租金管制法，以打击急剧涨价和牟取暴利。类似措施保护了城市住房的租户。1952 年政变结束最大地主的权力后，埃及实行土地改革，为佃农提供更广泛的保障，并给予城市房产居民类似保护。
en: The British attempted to consolidate the new arrangements of private property. They carried out a land survey, mapping the ownership of every acre of agricultural land in the country and recording the information in property registers. Completed in 1907, the survey and property register were more comprehensive than anything known in that period in Britain.

At the same time the colonial authorities were forced to introduce measures to limit the application of the new property rules. In 1912, in an attempt to slow down the rate at which villagers were losing their land and their homes to creditors, they introduced the Five Feddan Law.
Modelled on measures the British had introduced to deal with similar problems in Punjab in northwest India, the law prevented

creditors seizing from small farmers their last five acres (feddans) of land, their essential farm tools, two draft animals, and their house. Nevertheless, by the 1920s, it was estimated that more than one-third of the agricultural population in the Nile Delta had become landless.

The government introduced rent control laws during the Second World War, to combat steep price rises and profiteering. Similar measures protected tenants in urban housing. Following the 1952 coup d’etat that ended the power of the largest landowners, Egypt adopted a land reform that gave more extensive security to tenant farmers and similar protections to urban property dwellers.

zh: 埃及经验对自由与民主研究所更为当代的提案提出了若干问题。第一，欧洲人并非把在国内创造私有财产的成功视为理所当然，以至于忽视了在其他地区引入这种制度。若要说有哪种情况成立，倒是恰恰相反。欧洲关于私有财产之性质和重要性的许多现代思考，都是在殖民统治背景下形成的，无论是在爱尔兰、印度、埃及和澳大利亚的英国人，还是在北非和其他领土的法国人。
殖民地不同之处在于，当地有能力减缓或阻止资产化过程。
en: The Egyptian experience raises a number of questions about the ILD’s more contemporary proposals. First, it is not the case that Europeans took their success in creating private property at home so much for granted that they overlooked its introduction in other parts of the world. If anything, it was the other way round. Much of modern European thinking about the nature and importance of private property was worked out in the context of colonial rule, whether by the British in Ireland, India, Egypt, and Australia or the French in North Africa and other territories.
What was different in the colonies was the local ability to slow down or prevent the process of assetisation.

zh: 第二，德·索托忽视了一个事实：即使国内的“成功”也是有条件的，而且代价巨大。十八、十九世纪在英国巩固正式产权的人兴旺发达，但大多数人口并未如此。圈占农村社区共有土地、建立大型私有地产，迫使数十万家庭陷入贫困，被赶出乡村。在整个欧洲，数百万人被迫移居，前往城市，更多人迁往国外。他们去了北美和南美、澳大利亚、非洲南北部以及世界其他角落。在埃及和印度，当地人口有力量和政治组织来抵抗欧洲定居和土地收购造成的彻底失地；而在北美、澳大利亚等定居者殖民地，原住民被推到一边并逐渐消灭，以便欧洲财产所有权的扩张和正式化。
en: Second, de Soto overlooked the fact that even the success at home was a qualified one. It was achieved at great cost. Those who consolidated formal property rights in eighteenth- and nineteenth-century Britain, for example, prospered. But a large majority of the population did not. The enclosure of lands held in common by rural communities and the creation of large private estates forced hundreds of thousands of households into poverty and drove them from the countryside. Across Europe, millions were forced into emigration, moving to the cities and, in even greater numbers, abroad. They moved to North and South America, Australia, northern and southern Africa, and other corners of the world. In contrast to Egypt and India, where the local population had the power and the political organisation to resist the complete loss of their land to European settlement and land acquisition, in settler colonies like North America and Australia the native population was pushed aside and gradually eliminated, to enable the expansion and formalisation of European property ownership.

zh: 奇怪的是，德·索托在讨论这部全球私有财产史时，只详细考察了一个案例——而且大部分细节都缺失了。他描述了美国向西扩张

殖民过程中，如何把非正式所有者纳入正式财产制度，特别是加州占地者和矿工协会所确立的财产主张如何得到接受。在德·索托看来，这个案例例证了把非正式财产的“死”资本转变为国家承认并监管的法律秩序中的活资本的成功过程。他无视“死”资本问题本身部分是由正式化造成的事实。许多定居者被迫以占地者身份夺取土地，因为土地投机者已经控制了最新法定土地定居点之外较好的土地。他忽略了：在从墨西哥夺占该领土后，加州欧洲占地者和矿工的主张，是通过否认其所驱赶的大多数美洲原住民和墨西哥人口享有任何同等权利而确立的。而且，由于他把定居者殖民主义当作证据，他忽视了欧洲更大规模的剥夺和驱逐问题，而定居者殖民主义正是对这些问题的回应。只有剥去其历史的每一层，十九世纪加州的案例才会呈现为一种可供当代发展中国家改革者效仿的成功。
en: Curiously, de Soto’s discussion of this global history of private property examined only one case in detail – and most of the detail is missing. He describes the incorporation of informal owners into the formal property regime of the United States as the country expanded its

colonisation westward, in particular the acceptance of the property claims established by squatters’ and miners’ associations in California. This case exemplifies for de Soto the successful process of turning the ‘dead’ capital of informal property into the live capital of a legal order recognised and regulated by the state. He disregards the fact that the problem of ‘dead’ capital was itself partly created by formalisation. Many settlers had been forced to seize land as squatters because land speculators had taken control of the better land just beyond the most recent legal land settlements. He ignores the fact that the claims of European squatters and miners in California, following the seizure of the territory from Mexico, were established by denying any equivalent rights to most of the native American and Mexican populations they pushed aside. And, by using as evidence the example of settler colonialism, he overlooks the larger problems of dispossession and eviction back in Europe to which settler colonialism was a response. The case of nineteenth-century California illustrates a success that contemporary reformers in developing countries might emulate only if one strips it of every layer of its history.

zh: 与北美定居者殖民主义的成就及其给原住民社群带来的灾难相比，欧洲在埃及和印度等国的殖民主义不那么成功。它遇到的是土地占有安排已建立数百年的人口，其土地主张更难通过资产化和止赎予以根除，也无法将这些实际居住于此的人口消灭。即使在巴勒斯坦，犹太复国主义定居者曾希望利用资产化、土地购买、止赎和驱逐来暗中夺取整个国家，原住民人口也大体上进行了抵抗，导致定居者运动——如我们在上一章所述——转向以军事力量进行剥夺。在世界其他地区，尽管建立欧洲财产制度的尝试在若干国家引发了一系列“维多利亚晚期大屠杀”，数千人、有时数百万人丧生，大多数人口仍能抵抗彻底剥夺，并在二十世纪设法限制甚至扭转私有财产权力的实施。
en: In contrast to the achievements of settler colonialism of North America, and the disaster it entailed for native communities, European colonialism in countries like Egypt and India was less successful. It encountered populations whose land tenure arrangements had been established over several centuries, whose claims to the land were more difficult to eradicate through assetisation and foreclosure, and whose physical presence could not be eliminated. Even in Palestine, where Zionist settlers had hoped to use assetisation, land purchase, foreclosure, and eviction to take over the country by stealth, the native population largely resisted, causing the settler movement, as we noted in the last chapter, to turn to dispossession by military force. In other parts of the world, although the attempt to establish European property regimes helped trigger a series of ‘late Victorian holocausts’ in several countries, in which thousands and, in some cases, millions of people lost their lives, most populations were able to resist complete dispossession and in the twentieth century managed to limit and even roll back the implementation of the powers of private property.

zh: 虽然
无视正式产权发展所伴随的剥夺历史，德·索托却意识到，当前问题的关键取决于保障问题。他说，非正式财产安排的问题在于，它们让人们太有保障，其免于被剥夺的权利
受到太强的保护。他说，在西方之外，“法律和官方机构被早期殖民法和罗马法所困，这些法律偏向于保护所有权”。
如同十九世纪欧洲人在埃及所要求的那样，他所主张改革的一个核心要素就是取消这种保护。只有把规则和权力安排得使债权人能够夺取违约债务人的财产，土地和住房才能被资产化，作为扩大信贷的抵押品。
en: While

ignores the history of dispossession that accompanied the development of formal property rights, de Soto is aware that the issues at stake in the present hinge on questions of security. He says that the problem with informal property arrangements is that they leave people too secure, with their rights against dispossession
too strongly protected. Outside the West, he says, ‘the law and official agencies are trapped by early colonial and Roman law, which tilt towards protecting ownership’.

One of the central elements of the reforms that he advocates, as Europeans demanded in Egypt in the nineteenth century, is the removal of this protection. Land and housing can only be assetised, serving as collateral for the extension of credit, if rules and powers are arranged to enable creditors to seize the property of debtors who default.

zh: 虽然承认需要这些新权力，
却未能探讨它们可能导致何种后果。撇开上文所述的殖民历史不谈，即使在今天，这些后果也不难观察到。以美国农业为例。十九世纪美国扩张期间，土地主张被纳入正式财产制度的白人占地者，大多在二十世纪失去了财产。小农场主以及后来的中等农场主逐渐被淘汰。1930 年代至 1980 年代之间，三分之二的美国农场停业并失去财产。在推广德·索托思想时，这一剥夺过程完全被忽视。
一篇讨论自由与民主研究所面向贫困国家产权登记提案的文章指出：“在富国，如果农场主想投资更好的种子或更大的拖拉机，他大概可以用自己的土地作担保借到所需现金。”
这通常不是农场主想不想的问题，而是迫不得已。到 1980 年代，美国农用物资产业超过四分之三由四家公司控制，大多数农产品贸易也受类似垄断支配。农场主受到上下游垄断的挤压，不得不以财产作抵押借钱维持经营。止赎机制逐渐迫使他们离开土地。
土地被效率较低但更有权势的公司经营实体接管，这些公司利用其政治资源获得越来越大的政府补贴。全球南方国家永远无力承受让私有财产、抵押品和信贷机制造成如此规模灾难的后果。
en: Although it acknowledges the need for these new powers,

fails to explore the kinds of consequence to which they can lead. Leaving aside the colonial history outlined above, even today these consequences are not hard to observe. Take the example of farming in the United States. Most of the white squatters whose land claims were incorporated into the formal property system of the United States during its nineteenth-century expansion lost their property in the course of twentieth century. Small and later medium farm owners were gradually eliminated. Between the 1930s and the 1980s, two-thirds of American farms went out of business and lost their property. This process of dispossession is entirely overlooked in the promotion of de Soto’s ideas. ‘In rich countries’, notes an article in

discussing the ILD’s property titling proposals for poor countries, ‘if a farmer wants to invest in better seeds or bigger tractors, he can probably borrow the necessary cash using his land as security.’

This is not usually a question of what the farmer wants, more an issue of necessity. By the 1980s, more than three-quarters of the American farm supply industry was controlled by four firms, and similar monopolies governed trade in most farm products. Squeezed by monopolies on both sides, farmers were obliged to use their property as collateral to borrow money to stay in business. The mechanism of foreclosure gradually forced them off the land.

The land was taken over by less efficient but more powerful corporate operations, which used their political resources to gain ever-larger government subsidies. The countries of the Global South could never afford to allow the mechanisms of private property, collateral, and credit to produce a disaster on this scale.

zh: 上述事件轮廓提供了一种不同方式来理解这个问题：为什么埃及等国如此多的人持有尚未纳入正式财产制度的土地或住房？以及一个更大的问题：我们是否应把这些资产视为存在于市场经济“之外”，或资本主义之外？

这些安排之所以出现，不是因为这类国家的人民不懂私有财产，也不是因为西方忽视了把这一制度输出到国外的必要性。与欧洲和北美财产正式化和资产化的受害者不同，农村和城市人口能够延缓其实施、改变其路径或限制其范围。他们处于这些财产机制“之外”的位置，是对遭受剥夺的一种长期、往往暴力、但最终相对成功的抵制的结果——欧洲和北美农村人口遭受了这种剥夺，而在定居者殖民主义得以推行的世界部分地区，原住民人口则被彻底边缘化或消灭。
en: This outline of events suggests a different way of understanding the question of why so many people in countries such as Egypt hold land or housing that has not been incorporated into a formal property system, and the larger question of whether we should think of these assets as existing ‘outside’ the market economy, or outside capitalism. These

arrangements have not arisen because people in such countries are ignorant of private property or because the West overlooked the need to export the system abroad. Unlike the victims of property formalisation and assetisation in Europe and North America, rural and urban populations were able to delay, divert, or limit the extent of its implementation. Their position ‘outside’ these property mechanisms was the outcome of a long, often violent, but ultimately relatively successful objection to undergoing the dispossession inflicted on the rural populations of Europe and North America or the complete marginalisation or elimination of native populations in parts of the world where settler colonialism was carried through.

zh: 把这些事件的结果描述为存在一个市场之外的世界，实在奇怪。对自由与民主研究所来说，这个“外部”是由无知和缺乏机会造成的。正式安排的好处从未扩展到那里。更有启发性的做法是把这一结果视为一片边疆。人们看到正式财产安排推进、后退、再推进。他们有时避开这些安排，有时被其吞没。他们从内部与之斗争，有时又将其转为地方上的优势。这片边疆一直是战场。它不是一条标示市场与非市场、正式与非正式、资产化与非资产化之间屏障的细线。它是横跨整个市场空间、贯穿所谓资本主义全部历史的战争地带。如果这是一个外部，那么它是随处可见的外部，是一个似乎界定着可以辨识出正式制度或资本主义的每一个地点的战斗场景。因此，它是一个“包容性排除”的地带，因为被宣布处于市场之外的东西，已经通过这种排除宣言以及围绕纳入的持续斗争，在其中扮演了角色。
en: It is curious to describe the outcome of these events as the existence of a world outside the market. For the ILD, this outside is a place shaped by ignorance and lack of access. It is a place to which the benefits of formal arrangements were never extended. It would be more instructive to think of the outcome as a frontier. People have seen formal property arrangements advance, recede, and advance again. They have sometimes evaded them and sometimes been overtaken by them. They have worked against them from the inside and sometimes turned them to local advantage. The frontier has been a battleground. It is not a thin line marking the barrier between market and non-market, or formal and informal, or assetised and non-assetised. It is a terrain of warfare spread across the entire space of the market, the entire length of what is called the history of capitalism. If it is an outside, then it is an outside found everywhere, a scene of battle that seems to define every point at which the formal or the capitalist can be identified. It is therefore a zone of ‘inclusive exclusion’, since what is declared to be outside the market already plays a role within it, through the declaration of exclusion and the continuous battles over its inclusion.

zh: 家宅资产
en: Homely Assets

zh: 通过产权登记和资产化改造全球南方的提案，设想了三个不同步骤来纳入被宣布为排除在外的东西：把财产变为抵押品，把抵押品变为信贷，把信贷变为增加的收入。
有什么证据表明产权登记能够释放信贷，而新获得的信贷会带来这一系列后果？把市场“之外”的资产转变为市场之内金融繁荣的机制是什么？
en: The proposals for transforming the Global South through property titling and assetisation envision three distinct steps for including what is declared to be excluded: turning property into collateral, collateral into credit, and credit into increased income.

What is the evidence that property titling unlocks credit and that the newly available credit has this set of consequences? What is the mechanism that turns assets ‘outside’ the market into financial prosperity within?

zh: 对这个问题着墨很少。书中的主要论点是顺带提及一个观念：在美国，许多人用住房作抵押借款来创办小企业。这种信贷来源有多重要？德·索托对这一说法没有提供任何证据，而美国小企业信贷的现有数据也不提供多少支持。在极小型企业中，40% 根本不借款，而借款者最常见的来源是个人信用卡。
en: has little to say on this question. The main argument presented in the book is a passing reference to the idea that, in the United States, many people launch small businesses by borrowing funds using their homes as collateral. How significant is this source of credit? De Soto cites no evidence for the claim, and the data available on small business credit in the United States does not offer much support. Among very small businesses, 40 per cent borrow no funds at all and the most common source of loans for those that do is a personal credit card.

zh: 资产化和抵押住房在为商业投资融资方面的作用可能不如自由与民主研究所认为的那么重要，原因之一是，在西方，大多数人没有可供抵押的住房。虽然自有住房率从德国和瑞典的 40%、法国的 54%，到美国和英国高达 68% 不等，但这些数字包括已抵押但尚未还清贷款的住房，也包括居住者欠款超过房屋价值的情况。
从历史上看，自有住房率更低。例如在 1914 年之前的英国，多达 90% 的住房是私人租赁。
对西方大多数家庭来说，把住房用于商业贷款抵押并不是一个可选项。
en: One reason why assetising and mortgaging one’s home may play a less significant role in financing business investments than the ILD believes is that, in the West, most people do not have homes to mortgage. While home ownership rates range from 40 per cent in Germany and Sweden to 54 per cent in France and as high as 68 per cent in the United States and Britain, these figures include homes that are mortgaged and not yet paid for, including those whose occupants owe more than the value of the house.
Historically, rates of home ownership were even lower. In Britain, for example, before 1914, as much as 90 per cent of housing was privately rented.
For a majority of households in the West, using one’s home as collateral for a business loan is not an option available.

zh: 在全球南方，自有住房率往往高得多，例如印度和墨西哥超过 80%。
由于住房信贷在这些国家作用极小，大多数住房由房主全额持有，不负担购房贷款。
主张，南方的低收入房主拥有一些资产，如果他们生活在北方，就会把这些资产转化为活资本。事实上，他们拥有的资产，如果他们生活在北方，在大多数情况下根本就不会拥有。
en: In the Global South, rates of home ownership are often much higher, above 80 per cent in India and Mexico, for example.
Because of the minimal role of housing credit in these countries, most of these homes are owned outright.

argues that low-income homeowners in the South possess assets that, if they lived in the North, they would transform into live capital. In fact, they possess assets that, if they lived in the North, in most cases they would not own.

zh: 德·索托把全球南方的非正式财产制度描述为资本的一种缺陷形式。比较自有住房率的数据表明，它们或许反而应被视为一项重大成就。它们使数百万家庭能够居住在自己的住房中，免于抵押债务和止赎的威胁，尽管其收入只有西方家庭的一小部分，而西方能负担得起房产的家庭要少得多。
en: De Soto describes the informal property systems of the Global South as a defective form of capital. The figures on comparative homeownership rates suggest that they might, instead, be seen as a significant achievement. They enable millions of households to occupy their own dwellings, free of mortgage debt and the threat of foreclosure, even though their incomes are a fraction of those of households in the West, where far fewer can afford to own property.

zh: 至少从 1940 年代起，非正式住房的优点就得到承认。当时，埃及建筑师哈桑·法西等人提倡乡土住房，作为战后政府计划——出钱让商业承包商建造不宜居住且相对昂贵的混凝土公寓楼——的替代方案。
发展实践者（但与大型承包商有联系的政府除外）已广泛接受非正式住房具有显著优势，尤其是如果采取措施克服非正式性的一些缺点。这些缺点可能包括服务不足、场地布局差、权属无保障——但不包括无法用房产作抵押。
en: The advantages of informal housing have been recognised since at least the 1940s, when people like the Egyptian architect Hassan Fathy promoted vernacular housing as an alternative to the plans of postwar governments to pay commercial contractors to build inhospitable and relatively expensive blocks of concrete apartments.
By the 1970s, it

was widely accepted among development practitioners (but not by governments with ties to large contractors) that informal housing had significant advantages, especially if measures were taken to overcome some of the drawbacks of informality. These drawbacks might include inadequate services, poor site layout, and insecure tenure – but not an inability to use the property as collateral.

zh: 2004 年对埃及南部一个村庄的观察所得的证据，可以说明这些优势近年来如何继续发挥作用。

第一，非正式住房往往是自建的。在村里，住房从最贫困的几户人家居住的、用棕榈秆涂抹泥土搭成的简陋棚屋，到泥砖（土坯）建造的坚固房屋，再到钢筋混凝土框架和烧制砖块建成的四五层建筑，有时同一大家庭每层住一户。许多家庭自己建房，通常得到男性亲属的帮助。另一些家庭雇请建筑工，建筑工可能是亲戚或邻居，通常还会借助该家庭成员的帮忙。使用当地可得、有时免费的建材也降低了费用。砖由泥土制成，混凝土用当地沙子，天花板梁和板条来自椰枣树（通常是雄性树，不结果实）的树干和枝条。
窗户、门和家具由当地木匠制作，而较便宜的家具由修剪树木的男人们用棕榈秆组装。回收的油罐被锤打拼接起来，做成最简陋房屋的门。安装电气和管道系统时，一些家庭雇请电工和水管工，但多数家庭能够自己安装，或在亲戚帮助下完成。这种自建、亲属服务和地方手艺行业的混合，使住房价格可负担，同时也支撑了相当规模的地方建筑业。
en: Evidence drawn from observations of a village in southern Egypt in 2004 can illustrate how its advantages still operated in recent years.

First, informal housing is often self-built. In the village, houses range from simple huts built of palm stalks plastered with mud, occupied by a few of the poorest households, to substantial houses made of mud brick (adobe), to four- and five-storey structures built with reinforced concrete frames and fired brick, sometimes accommodating a separate household of the same extended family on each floor. Many households build their own dwellings, often with the help of male relatives. Others hire a builder, who may be a relative or neighbour and usually employs help from the household. Expenses are also reduced by using building materials available locally, sometimes at no cost. Bricks are made from the earth, concrete from local sand, and ceiling joists and laths from the trunks and branches of date palms (usually the male trees, which do not produce fruit).

Windows, doors, and furniture are made by local carpenters, while cheaper furniture is assembled from palm stalks by the men who trim the trees. Recycled oil cans are hammered together to make doors for the simplest houses. To install electrical and plumbing systems some households employ electricians and plumbers, but most are able to install these systems themselves or with the help of a relative. This mixture of self-building, the services of relatives, and local crafts and trades keeps housing affordable while also supporting a significant local construction industry.

zh: 非正式、主要靠自建住房的其他优势包括：可以选择逐步建造，随着需求的发展和收入的到账，增建房间、楼层或添置设施，甚至日后用更耐久的材料重建整座住宅；使用适合当地的方法和建材；能够按居住者需要设计房屋布局，并在需求变化时加以改动——例如把前屋改成一间小店铺，或把后院改成作坊。
en: Other advantages of informal, largely self-built housing include the option to build incrementally, adding extra rooms, floors, or fixtures as needs develop and income arrives, or even to rebuild the entire dwelling in more durable materials later on; the use of locally appropriate methods and building supplies; and the ability to design the layout of the house to suit the occupants’ needs and to alter it as those needs change – converting a front room into a small store, for example, or a rear yard into a workshop.

zh: 自建农村住房的成功取决于这样一个事实：它很少需要购买土地，而土地超出大多数家庭的负担能力。新住房的空间靠拆除较旧、

较不坚固或需要翻新的建筑，靠扩建现有房屋、往往以减少原先用于家畜的土地为代价，或靠填补住宅之间的空隙来获得。没有土地建房的人寻找小块空地。有些人找到政府承认占地者住房并收取小额租金的高处、不可耕种地块。另一些人找到自己或亲戚农地的未用边缘，通常沿运河和道路边缘，或耕作区与沙漠交界处。1971 年阿斯旺高坝建成后，可以在农地上建房；此前，每年为灌溉而淹没田地的做法，使大部分农地免于被用于建房。1983 年通过的一项禁止在农地上建房的法令，以及 1996 年一项军事命令的强化，减少了农田损失，但未能消除这种做法。
2011 年革命起义之后，农地上不受监管的建造激增。2018 年的进一步立法和 2022 年出台的更严厉处罚，都未能阻止农田流失。
大多数新建筑位于现有村庄边界内或未利用土地上。然而，未利用地块短缺，加上政府无法促进沿沙漠边缘、军事用地和其他未充分利用土地的自建项目，加剧了获得适当地块的问题。
en: The success of self-built rural housing depends on the fact that it seldom requires the purchase of land, which would be beyond the reach of most families. Space for new housing is found by pulling down older,

less substantial structures or those in need of renewal, by adding to existing houses, often by reducing the land previously used for domestic animals, or by filling the gaps between dwellings. Those who own no land on which to build look for small plots of vacant land. Some find patches of higher, uncultivable ground, where the government recognises squatter housing and charges a small rent. Others find the unused margin of their own or a relative’s plot of agricultural land, typically along the edges of canals and roads or at the border where the cultivation meets the desert. The completion of the Aswan High Dam in 1971 made it possible to build on agricultural land, much of which was previously protected from building by the annual flooding of the fields for irrigation. A law passed in 1983 to ban construction on agricultural land, and reinforced by a military order of 1996, reduced the loss of farmland but failed to eliminate the practice.

Following the revolutionary uprisings of 2011, there was a surge in unregulated building on agricultural land. Further legislation in 2018 and harsher penalties introduced in 2022 were unable to prevent the loss of farmland.

Most new construction takes place within existing village boundaries or on unused land. However, the shortage of unused plots as well as the inability of the government to facilitate self-build projects along the desert margin and on military property and other underutilised land exacerbates the problem of access to suitable land.
body.review: 校注：底本称阿斯旺高坝于1971年建成。埃及水资源与灌溉部工程史区分了1970年7月主体工程完成与1971年1月15日正式揭幕两个时间节点。正文保留底本年份，读者宜注意竣工与揭幕口径之别。 https://www.mwri.gov.eg/?page_id=33310&lang=en

zh: 以这种方式建造的住房可能是合法的、半合法的（例如违反建筑法规），或非法的（例如在农地上建造的住房）。所有业主都希望自己的住房合法，但不是因为他们打算把住房用作抵押品。合法住房不必承担违法建筑因频繁传唤和罚款而产生的费用，也可能更容易接通水和电。后者自 1990 年代以来已不那么成问题，当时一系列政府法令规定，违反农地建房禁令或建筑法规建造的住房，仍有资格接通公用设施。
en: The housing built in this way may be legal, semi-legal (infringing building regulations, for example), or illegal (such as housing built on agricultural land). All owners would prefer their homes to be legal, but not because they plan to use them as collateral. Legal housing does not carry the expense of the frequent summonses and fines imposed on unlawful construction and may be easier to connect to the water and electricity supply. The latter has been less of a problem since the 1990s, when a series of government decrees ruled that houses built in violation of laws banning construction on agricultural land or of building regulations were nevertheless eligible for connection to utilities.

zh: 然而，合法也有缺点。主要问题是它使土地变得难以负担。2004 年，村里农地售价约为每基拉特 1,000 埃镑。
有时，农业部会把一块土地从村庄的耕地范围（
）中移出，例如因为它被建筑包围，不再获得足够日照而无法耕种。这使该地块可以合法建房。合法化使土地价值至少升至原来的十倍，达到每基拉特 10,000 埃镑以上。在更有价值的地点，
例如主要城镇边缘的农地，合法化可使价值升至原来的三十到四十倍。
en: Legality, however, also has drawbacks. The main problem is that it makes land unaffordable. In 2004, agricultural land in the village sold for about e£1,000 per qirat.
Occasionally, the Ministry of Agriculture would remove a plot of land from the cultivated area (the

) of the village; for example, because it was surrounded by buildings and no longer received enough sunlight for cultivation. This made it legal to build on the plot. Legalisation increased the value of land by a factor of at least ten, to more than e£10,000 per qirat. In more valuable locations,
such as agricultural land on the edge of a major town, legalisation could increase the value by a factor of thirty or forty.

zh: 城市住房在若干方面明显不同于农村住房，但许多相同的原则仍然适用。在埃及，1967—74 年占领结束后以色列军队撤出苏伊士运河区，伊斯梅利亚城的重建包括一个成功项目，展示了“地块与基础设施”计划的优势——既促进自建，又避免服务不足、场地布局差和权属无保障的问题。

这个自筹资金项目提供了配有建筑地块和基础设施的开发用地，以及小额贷款和低成本建材供应。地块获得者有很长时间来偿还土地的未改良价值。要求立即建造、业主自住和延迟取得产权的规定，抑制了投机者和资产化。该项目认识到，提供正式土地产权可能妨碍低成本住房供应，因为这鼓励房地产投机者通过资产化抬高房价。反过来，如果不能通过业主自住等要求来抑制资产化，住房就会变得更难负担、更少可得。2016 年，据估计埃及城市有 640 万套住房空置。
en: Urban housing differs in several obvious ways from rural, yet many of the same principles apply. In Egypt, the rebuilding of the city of Ismailiya following the withdrawal of the Israeli army from the Suez Canal zone after the 1967–74 occupation included a successful project to demonstrate the advantages of ‘site and service’ programmes to facilitate self-building while avoiding the problems of inadequate services, poor site layout, and insecure tenure.

The self-funding project made available development sites laid out with building tracts and services, along with small loans and supplies of low-cost building materials. The recipients of the plots were given long periods to repay the unimproved value of the land. Provisions requiring immediate construction, owner occupancy, and delayed acquisition of title discouraged speculators and assetisation. The project recognised that offering formal title to the land can hamper the provision of low-cost housing, as it encourages property speculators, by assetising housing, to bid up its price. Conversely, the failure to discourage assetisation, through requirements such as owner occupancy, makes housing less affordable and less available. In 2016, it was estimated that 6.4 million housing units in urban Egypt were unused.

zh: 财产的边界
en: Boundaries of Property

zh: 自由与民主研究所承认非正式住房的许多优点。然而其提案坚持认为，通过产权登记实现正式化是经济发展的唯一道路。这一坚持基于的不是非正式住房的相对好处，而是获得抵押品和信贷的机会。它声称，只有正式财产制度才能释放非正式住房中持有的死资本。现在是时候更具体地转向这一论点——一个关于通过资本化实现发展的论点。
en: The ILD acknowledges many of the advantages of informal housing. Yet its proposals insist that formalisation through property titling is the only route to economic development. The insistence is based on an argument not about the relative benefits of the informal but about access to collateral and credit. Only a formal property system, it is claimed, can release the dead capital held in informal housing. It is time to turn more specifically to this argument – an argument about development through capitalisation.

zh: 埃及农村再次提供了可供开端的证据。尽管自由与民主研究所为埃及起草的提案集中于城市住房正式化，但在之前十年，他们主张的一些改革已在农村实施。这些改革（实际上是撤销早先对农业财产市场设限的改革）包括允许农民用土地作为农业发展
银行贷款抵押品的措施，以及逐步取消农地租金管制，最终于 2002 年废除所有租佃保障。此后，地主可以自由重新谈判租金，甚至驱逐佃户——这些家庭在多数情况下自 1952 年土地改革之前就以名义租金耕种土地。两项改革合在一起，似乎恰好许诺了
所描述的东西：让业主释放锁定在土地中的资本，或者把土地抵押贷款，或者以更高收入水平出租。
en: Once again, the case of rural Egypt provides evidence with which to begin. Although the proposals the ILD drew up for Egypt were focused on the formalisation of urban housing, over the preceding decade some of the reforms they advocated had already been carried out in the countryside. The reforms (actually, the undoing of earlier reforms that had set limits on the agrarian property market) included measures allowing farmers to use their land as collateral for loans from the Agricultural

Development Bank, and a gradual lifting of rent controls on agricultural land, culminating in the abolition of all security of tenure in 2002. After that date, landowners were free to renegotiate rents or even evict their tenants – households that in most cases had been farming the land at nominal rents since before the land reform of 1952. Taken together, the two reforms seemed to promise exactly what
described, enabling owners to free up the capital locked in their land, either by pledging it as collateral for loans or renting it at increased levels of income.
body.review: 校注：本段及下段将农地租佃保障取消记为2002年。Reem Saad在英国学术院发表的1992年租佃法研究指出，1992年第96号法给予地主在五年过渡期后驱逐佃户的权利，过渡期于1997年结束。底本年份与该法时间表不符；正文照录。 https://www.thebritishacademy.ac.uk/documents/3888/96p387.pdf

zh: 当时没有足够证据对改革的影响作出一般性结论，部分原因是各村情况差异很大。例如，在该国一些地区，整个小村落耕种从单一所有者租来的土地。在这些情况下，2002 年废除租佃保障，把整个社群从土地的实际占有人变为无地农民，他们要么失去使用土地的机会，要么被迫以高得多的租金租地。在我一直描写的这个村庄里，出租地块分散得多。这往往有利于佃户。三户人家——都是兄弟——合种四英亩土地，其中三英亩自有，一英亩租来。出租一英亩的所有者住在同村一个邻近小村落，是原所有者的第二代继承人，根本不知道自家土地的确切位置。这块地位于另外三英亩中间的某处，但由于埃及的单块土地没有树篱或其他永久边界标志，无法确定其位置。原租赁合同规定了它相对于其他地块的位置，但那些地块也没有标记。即使所有者设法找到了自家地块，他们也无法把灌溉水引到那里。他们未曾获得使用穿过邻居田地的沟渠的权利，也没有单独的沟渠供应这一英亩。所有者要求把年租金从 300 埃镑（约 50 美元）提高到 1,200 埃镑。兄弟们拒绝，最终同意支付 600 埃镑。如果所有者不是来自邻近小村落，兄弟们还会付得更少。
en: There was insufficient evidence to draw any general conclusions about the impact of the reforms, in part because circumstances vary greatly from one village to another. In some parts of the country, for instance, entire hamlets farmed land rented from a single owner. In these cases, the abolition of security of tenure in 2002 transformed the whole community from effective possessors of the land into landless farmers, who either lost access to the land or were forced to rent at much higher rates. In the village about which I have been writing, the rental plots were much more widely dispersed. This tended to favour the tenants. One group of three households, all brothers, together farmed four acres of land, three acres of which they owned and one of which they rented. The owners of the rented acre lived in a neighbouring hamlet of the same village but were the second-generation heirs of the original owner and had no idea of the exact location of their land. It lay somewhere in the middle of the other three acres, but, since individual plots in Egypt have no hedgerows or other permanent boundary markers, there was no way to establish its position. The original rental contract specified its position in relation to other plots of land, but these were also unmarked. Even if the owners had managed to locate their plot, they would not have been able to bring irrigation water to it. They had established no rights to use the ditches that carried water across neighbours’ fields, and no separate ditch supplied their acre. The owner demanded an increase in annual rent from e£300 (about US$50) to e£1,200. The brothers refused and eventually agreed to pay e£600. If the owners had not been from a nearby hamlet, the brothers would have paid even less.

zh: 这个案例——若干类似案例之一——说明了一些有用的要点。第一，就新法增加业主权利的方面而言，其效果并不是把死资本变成活资本。所有者提高了租金，但增加部分来自佃农，他们的收入每年减少 300 埃镑。这标志着财富从农民的生产性劳动

转向食租者的非生产性劳动。第二，这种收入转移受财产记录薄弱的限制。出租一英亩的所有者无法完全确立其土地主张，使佃农得以支付较低租金。耕种者关于土地的地方知识，比德·索托视为资本主义发展秘诀的不完整“抽象”产权知识更有效力。这种知识的不完整，限制了收入从耕种和熟悉土地的人手中转入相对陌生者手中的程度。正式财产制度破坏这种地方知识，把所有权与所谓更抽象、肯定更遥远的各种形式连接起来，这些形式可以被外人积累、管理并当作租金来源。防止这类知识落入外人之手或财产登记册，是保护地方收入的一种资源。
en: This case, one of several similar cases that came to light, illustrates some useful points. First, to the extent that the new law increased the rights of property owners, its effect was not to turn dead capital into live. The owners increased their rent, but the increase came from the tenant farmers, whose income declined by e£300 a year. This marked a

shift in wealth from the productive labour of farmers to the unproductive labour of a rentier. Second, this transfer of income was limited by the weakness of property records. The inability of the owners of the rented acre to establish fully their claim to the land enabled the tenant farmers to pay a lower rent. The local knowledge of those who farmed the land was more powerful than the incomplete ‘abstract’ knowledge of property entitlement that de Soto sees as the secret to capitalist development. The incompleteness of such knowledge was a means of limiting the diversion of income away from those who worked and knew the land, into the hands of relative strangers. Formal property systems undermine this local knowledge by linking ownership into what are called more abstract, certainly more distant, forms, which can be accumulated, managed, and made sources of rent by outsiders. Preventing the transfer of this kind of knowledge into the hands of outsiders or property registers was a resource for protecting local income.

zh: 这一案例并非孤立。村里有许多类似案例。它们得到我们关于财产积累和不平等创造的所有证据的印证。正式法定产权和财产登记的产生，成为资产化的机器，从而使财产从小所有者手中转移，集中到越来越大的所有者手中。我们已经注意到这台机器在十九世纪中叶至二十世纪中叶埃及的运作，以及政府被迫采取的限制其效力的措施。巴拉圭农村一项土地产权登记计划的证据表明，收益只流向相对富裕的生产者。

进一步证据来自新农业法另一部分对村庄的影响——农业发展银行取得土地作为贷款抵押品、并在借款人违约时夺取土地的新权力。几年之内，就有几起农民因此失去土地的案例，而且违约者无一例外都是小所有者。唯一有能力购买以这种方式释放之土地的人，是极少数大所有者，在数千户中不过十来户。其他研究显示了用土地作抵押品的其他不利后果。家庭用土地作抵押时，不得不在计算中加入相对低效的保险措施，以应对歉收或其他意外冲击，办法是坚持种植低风险、低回报作物——在埃及这一地区是甘蔗。
鉴于这些缺点，更有效的做法是积累和使用那些即使损失，对家庭造成的
灾难性打击也较小的信用形式，例如生产和储存粮食、饲养牲畜。
en: This case was not an isolated one. There were numerous similar cases in the village. Together, they are corroborated by all the evidence we have about the accumulation of property and the creation of inequality. The creation of formal legal title and property registration becomes a machinery for assetisation and hence for transferring property from small owners and concentrating it into larger and larger hands. We have already noted the operation of this machinery in Egypt between the mid-nineteenth and mid-twentieth century, and the measures the government was forced to adopt to limit its effectiveness. Evidence from a land titling programme in rural Paraguay suggests that gains go only to relatively wealthy producers.

Further evidence comes from the impact on the village of the other part of the new agrarian laws – the new powers of the Agricultural Development Bank to take land as collateral for loans, and to seize the land if the borrower defaults. Within a few years there were several cases of farmers losing their land by this mechanism, and in every case the defaulters were small owners.
