The only people in a position to buy land that became available in this way were the small handful of large owners, no more than a dozen households out of several thousand. Other studies show other adverse consequences of using land as collateral. When households use their land as collateral they have to add to their calculations relatively inefficient insurance measures that help them deal with poor harvests or other unexpected shocks, by keeping to low-risk, low-return crops – sugar cane in this region of Egypt.
Given these drawbacks, it is more efficient to build up and draw upon forms of credit whose loss is less
catastrophic to the household, such as producing and storing grain and raising animals.

zh: 用财产作信贷抵押品的另一个问题是，穷人很少能从资产损失中恢复。他们往往被迫在几乎没有有效需求时（衰退期间或歉收之后）低价出售财产，而在正常时期价格较高时又不得不买回来。
从历史上看，这类困境中的被迫出售在财产所有权集中中发挥了重要作用，并与地方风险管理方式的丧失相关。
en: A further problem with using property as collateral for credit is that the poor are seldom able to recover from asset losses. They are often forced to sell property at low prices (during a recession or after a bad harvest), when there is little effective demand, and have to buy back in normal times, when prices are higher.
Historically, such distress sales play an important role in the concentration of property ownership, and are connected with the loss of local ways of managing risk.

zh: 至于声称的用财产作贷款抵押品的好处呢？现有证据表明，正面影响很小，甚至没有。如果非正式财产持有者寻求产权，那也不是为了用它担保贷款而使财产承受风险。自由与民主研究所自己设计并管理的秘鲁产权登记计划是同类中规模最大的之一，清楚表明了这一点。四项独立研究都发现，该计划对商业信贷供给没有可察觉的影响。
正如一项研究所总结的，“标准商业银行和非正式贷款机构的贷款申请批准率都不受住房所有权状况影响”。
泰国一项大型产权登记计划也被发现不影响获得银行贷款的可能性。
其他农村产权登记计划研究则发现，“产权可能使大生产者更容易获得信贷，但不会使小土地所有者达到贷款机构的授信要求，这种情况会加深原先的不平等”。
产权登记计划还可能在其他方面产生不利后果。在男子与正式制度打交道的场合，妇女可能失去她们在非正式财产制度下拥有的主张。按需登记产权“往往给穷人带来灾难性后果，因为政治关系良好的人常常能够绕过原住民、妇女或其他弱势群体的土地权利”。
世界银行发展经济学家的研究、出版物和会议汇集了数十个案例研究的证据，表明自由与民主研究所的提案行不通。
en: What about the alleged benefits of being able to use property as collateral for loans? The evidence available shows that there is little or no positive impact. If those with informal property seek title, it is not to risk it in taking out loans. The titling programme the ILD itself devised and managed in Peru, one of the largest, demonstrated this clearly. Four separate studies of the programme found that it had no discernible effect on the supply of business credit.
As one study concluded, ‘loan acceptance rates of both standard commercial banks and informal lenders are unaffected by residential ownership status’.
A large property titling programme in Thailand was also found to have no effect on the likelihood of receiving bank loans.

Other studies of rural titling programmes have found that ‘the title might make it easier for large producers to access credit but would not make small landowners creditworthy, a situation that would deepen preexisting inequalities’.

Titling programmes can have adverse consequences in other ways as well. Women may lose claims they have under informal property systems, in situations where men deal with the formal system. Titling on demand ‘has often had disastrous consequences for the poor because individuals with good political connections can often bypass the land rights of indigenous people, women, or other vulnerable groups’.

Research, publications, and conferences organised by development economists at the World Bank brought together the evidence from dozens of case studies indicating that the ILD’s proposals would not work.

zh: 我们在这里面对的不再是一个简单图景：死资本躺在市场之外、正式经济的边界之外。我们看到的是另一幅图景：这条边界变成谈判、权利主张、权力关系、侵占和排除尝试的地带。问题不是把资产从边界外转移到边界内，而是权力、不平等和贫困的重新安排。
en: We are no longer dealing here with a simple image of dead capital lying outside the market, beyond the boundary of the formal economy. We have a different picture, in which this boundary turns into a terrain of negotiations, the claiming of rights, relations of power, attempts at encroachment and exclusion. Rather than a problem of transferring assets from outside the boundary to inside, there are rearrangements of power, inequality, and poverty at stake.

zh: 有所可失
en: Having to Lose

zh: 那么，现在该考虑的不是资本的奥秘，而是
的奥秘。它的论点似乎以一种缺陷形式存在，无视历史经验，也没有任何现有当代证据的支持。是什么神秘过程把这类有缺陷的分析转变为活生生的政治项目？
en: It is time to consider, then, not the mystery of capital, but the mystery of

. Its arguments appear to exist in defective form, ignoring historical experience and unsupported by any of the available contemporary evidence. What is the mysterious process that transforms such defective analysis into live political projects?

zh: 似乎没有证据支持自由与民主研究所的论点——产权登记是解开西方之外资本主义发展问题的钥匙。大量证据表明，这无助于改善现状；而且有充分理由认为，对大多数人口来说，这会让他们的未来更糟。这些研究对具体项目的成败作了详细评估，而自由与民主研究所关于全球转型的笼统提案完全缺少这类评估。既然如此，这些论点从哪里获得力量？它们又如何传播得如此广泛？
en: There appears to be no evidence to support the ILD’s argument for property titling as the key to unlocking the problem of capitalist development outside the West. There exists a large amount of evidence to indicate that this will do nothing to improve the situation, and a strong case can be made that for the majority of the population it will make things worse for their futures. These studies provide the kind of detailed evaluations of the success and failure of particular projects that is entirely missing from the ILD’s sweeping proposals for global transformation. Given this evidence, where do such arguments acquire their power? How do they come to circulate so widely?

zh: 前文所述德·索托项目通过新自由主义政治网络进行的营销，提供了部分答案；德·索托对解决资本主义奥秘之专有技术的主张，也提供了部分答案。但仅凭这些，无法解释他所主张的特定纲领为何被迅速采纳，而该纲领只是若干新自由主义政治改革之一。世界银行、美国国际开发署和其他资助德·索托项目机构的报告表明，该纲领与其他新自由主义改革的不同之处在于，它似乎格外具有成本效益。
它似乎提供某种东西，却几乎不费分文。我们被告知，全球南方的问题在于人们贫穷。自由与民主研究所提供的不是财富，而是一种在未来实现无人知晓他们拥有的财富的手段。这种效果是如何实现的？
en: The marketing of de Soto’s project through the political networks of neoliberalism, described earlier, provides part of the answer, as does de Soto’s claim to proprietary techniques for solving the mystery of capitalism. But these alone do not explain the rapid adoption of the particular programme de Soto advocates, which is one of several kinds of neoliberal political reform. The reports of the World Bank, USAID, and other agencies that have funded de Soto’s programme suggest that what distinguishes the programme from other neoliberal reforms is that it appears to be extraordinarily cost-effective.

It seems to offer something for almost nothing. The problem of the Global South, we are told, is that people are poor. The ILD offers them, not riches, but a means of realising wealth in the future that no one knew they had. How is this effect achieved?

zh: 几乎无需付出成本就获得收益的可能性，建立在市场有一个“外部”的观念上。如果没有各种安排让事物可以说是存在于经济之外，那么“用目前被视为无物的东西创造货币”这一提案就毫无意义。货币将因看似把资源从外部移入内部的操作而无中生有。市场之外地点的产生，创造了价值既存在又不存在的资产的可能。资产作为物质财富存在，但不是作为资本存在。把这种有缺陷的财富带入经济内部的行为，把它从惰性之物变成活跃之物，从死变为生。
en: The possibility of getting something for nothing rests on the notion that the market has an ‘outside’. The proposal that money can be created out of what presently counts as nothing would make no sense without arrangements whereby things can be said to exist outside the economy. Money is to be created out of nothing by the action of seeming to move resources from the outside to the inside. The production of a place outside the market creates the possibility of assets whose value is both existent and non-existent. The assets exist as material wealth, but not as capital. The act of bringing this defective wealth inside the economy transforms it from something inert into something active, from death to life.

zh: 这种外部与内部之间边界的说法之所以有力量，并非来自它对经济关系的描述准确。它来自为确立这种包容性排除、执行资产转移而提供的工具和论点。自由与民主研究所帮助整理未记录资产的数据，识别其流动障碍，并具体说明这种转移所需的法律和金融机制。它的工作帮助把地方政客、国际金融机构、房地产开发商甚至穷人代言人的特定联盟拉到一起，以执行这种转移。与此同时，它试图让其他类型的主张和其他形式的政治噤声。
en: The power of this account of a boundary between an outside and an inside does not arise from the accuracy of its description of economic relations. It comes from the tools and arguments that are made available for establishing this inclusive exclusion and performing the transfer of assets. The ILD helps organise the data on unrecorded assets, identify obstacles to their movement, and specify legal and financial mechanisms needed for this transfer. Its work helps pull together particular alliances of local politicians, international financial institutions, property developers, and even spokespersons for the poor, to carry out the transfer. At the same time, it attempts to silence other kinds of claims and other forms of politics.

zh: 让我们更仔细地考察，把资产从市场“之外”移入“之内”的操作如何使资本得以产生。当未纳入正式制度的住房或土地的所有者取得正式产权时，财产价值往往上升。如前所述，在村里，使土地可以合法建房会使其价值升至原来的十倍。在非正式住房已经建成的地方，合法化带来的价值增幅较小，但仍然显著。在巴西，一项产权登记计划使土地价值翻了一倍。
另一项研究发现增幅为 25%，其他估算介于这两个数字之间。
这些增长在意料之中。正如世界银行一项关于农地产权登记的研究所解释的，“把未抵押土地用作抵押品的能力之价值，会资本化进土地价格”。
en: Let us consider more closely how the action of moving assets from ‘outside’ the market to the inside brings capital into being. When owners of irregular housing or land acquire formal title, the value of the property tends to increase. In the village, as noted above, making land legal for building increases its value by a factor of ten. Where informal housing is already built, the increase in value that comes with legalisation is less, but still significant. In Brazil, a property titling programme led to a doubling in the value of land.
Another study found an increase of 25 per cent, and other estimates fell between these two figures.

These increases are to be expected. As a World Bank study explained in relation to the titling of agricultural land, ‘the value of the ability to use unmortgaged land as collateral would be capitalised into land prices’.

zh: 原则上，所有未纳入正式制度的财产的所有者都从这种价值增长中受益。但极少有人能出售房产，因为那会使他们无家可归。无论如何，购买另一处房产的需要也会抵消任何收益。只有那些持有房产不是为自身需要、而是为投机的人才会受益。同样，由于已经讨论过的原因，只有富有的所有者才能承担用住房作贷款抵押品的风险，并把增加的价值变成投资信贷。随着时间推移，产权登记导致财产集中到那些有能力按目前更高价值购买的人手中，并创造出投机者，这些人也因为此类房产如今提供的租金收入机会而受益。
en: In principle, all owners of irregular property benefit from this increase in value. But very few can sell their properties, since that would leave them homeless. In any case, the need to purchase another property would eliminate any gain. Only those holding property not for their own needs but for speculation would benefit. Likewise, for reasons already discussed, only wealthy owners could take the risk of using their dwelling as collateral for a loan and turn its increased value into credit for investments. Over time, titling leads to the concentration of property in the hands of those able to purchase it at the higher values it now commands, and creates speculators, who also benefit from the opportunities for income from the rent that such property now offers.

zh: 财产价值的增长有两个来源，其中没有一个代表“死”资本被激活。短期内，增长来自投机性投资。这种投资只是把信贷创造从更具生产性的项目中抽走，加剧了因缺乏对创造就业活动的投资而造成的更广泛问题。但财产价值增长的绝大部分
只有在较长期内、当下一代人寻求住房时才能实现。土地成本上升使未来住房更加昂贵。它如今带有支付投机者和食租者收入的溢价。因此，那些在当下为希望未来建造的房屋储蓄的人，必须更努力、更长久地工作，存更多的钱。
en: The increase in property value comes from two sources, neither of which represents ‘dead’ capital brought to life. In the short term, it comes from speculative investment. Such investment simply draws credit creation away from more productive ventures, exacerbating broader problems caused by the lack of investment in activities that create employment. But the bulk of any increase in property value is

realised only in the longer term, when the next generation of individuals seeks housing. The rising cost of land makes future housing more expensive. It now carries the premium of paying the income of speculators and rentiers. So those saving in the present for a house they hope to build in the future must work harder and longer and save more funds.

zh: 结果是财富的代际转移。大所有者和投机者立即从财产价值增长中获益。小财产所有者则看不到价值增长带来的好处。大所有者和投机者的收益，由未来一代所有者支付，他们面临为住房支付越来越多钱的前景。这种“收益”是从未来攫取的。
en: The outcome is an intergenerational transfer of wealth. Large owners and speculators gain immediately from the increased value of property. Small owners of property see no benefit from increased values. The gains of large owners and speculators are paid for by a future generation of owners, who face the prospect of paying increasing amounts for housing. The ‘gain’ is a capture from the future.

zh: 怎么可能对这种从穷人向富人的代际财富转移重新安排，使它看起来像免费的钱，像把死资本变成活资本的简单行为？实现这一壮举的重要手段，是从一个假定开始：资本主义有一个“奥秘”，一个在德·索托文本中再现之前不可见的秘密。甚至在秘密被揭示和争论之前，存在这种奥秘的许诺就解除了文本读者或自由与民主研究所政策提案接受者的武装。据说资本主义有一个隐藏的钥匙或原则。剥夺、主张、暴力、组织和抵抗有多种形式，我们一直在讨论它们的多样性和流动性；这些形式被想象为表达着一个潜在原则，其名为资本主义。我们被告知，在多样性和暴力之下，有某种规则或法则，其隐藏存在使每一个历史案例都成为同一神秘本质形式的表达。德·索托成功的奥秘始于这个观念：存在一个奥秘。这确实是资本的托词的一部分。
en: How is it possible to reorganise this intergenerational transfer of wealth from the poor to the rich so that it appears as free money, as a simple act of turning dead capital into live? An important means of achieving this feat is to begin with the assumption that there is a ‘mystery’ to capitalism, a secret that is not visible until it is represented in de Soto’s text. Even before the secret is revealed and argued over, the promise that there is such a mystery disarms the reader of the text, or the recipient of the ILD’s policy proposals. Capitalism is said to have a hidden key or principle. The multiple forms of expropriation, claim, violence, organisation, and resistance whose diversity and motility we have been discussing are imagined to express an underlying principle, whose name is capitalism. Beneath the diversity and violence, we are told, there is some rule or law, whose hidden existence makes every historical case an expression of the same mysterious essential form. The mystery of de Soto’s success begins with the notion that there is a mystery. This indeed is part of the alibi of capital.

zh: 在德·索托的案例中，资本主义奥秘的钥匙是我们此前在本书第一章遇到过的人物：企业家。拥有闲置资产可供创业的人越多，资本主义就越多。人们期望，向大量人口提供用财产作贷款抵押品的机会，会产生这种资本主义转变。
en: In de Soto’s case, the key to the mystery of capitalism is the figure we have met before, in the first chapter of this book: the entrepreneur. The more people there are with spare assets for entrepreneurship, the more capitalism there will be. Offering large numbers of people the opportunity to use their property as collateral for loans was expected to produce this capitalist transformation.

zh: 当对自由与民主研究所秘鲁产权登记改革的连续几项研究都表明改革没有产生预期结果、用财产作抵押品的做法也没有增加时，经济学家仍然找到了积极结果。一项关于改革影响的研究声称表明，虽然新获产权所有者未能用住房作抵押，他们确实获得了重要好处：开始更努力地工作。据说数据显示，在屋外工作的小时数惊人地增加了 40%。
研究作者主张，产权登记必定使住户摆脱了留在家中保卫财产的需要，使他们能够在市场上寻求更多就业。正是这项研究被
报道为自由与民主研究所改革产生显著影响的证据，并让另一位重要经济学家对经济学的未来抱有希望。
en: When successive studies of the ILD’s property titling reforms in Peru all showed that they had not had the predicted results, and that there was no increase in the use of property as collateral, economists still found a positive outcome. A study of the impact of the reforms claimed to show that, while newly titled property owners failed to use their houses as collateral, they did realise an important benefit. They began to work harder. The data was said to show an astonishing 40 per cent

increase in the number of hours worked outside the house. The author of the study argued that property titling must have freed householders from the need to stay home to defend their property, enabling them to seek more employment in the market. It was this research that was reported in the
as evidence of the remarkable impact of the ILD’s reforms and gave another leading economist hope for the future of economics.

zh: 是什么使这篇论文如此受欢迎？它提供了一个图景：住户突然能够放下他们被迫用来在市场之外无法无天的世界里保护自身权利的武器。产权得到保障后，他们走向有利可图、和平的市场世界，在那里辛勤工作如今将得到回报。然而不幸的是，用于支持该论文结论的证据却显示，这些结论完全错了。
en: What made the paper so popular? It offers an image of householders suddenly able to put down the weapons with which they were forced to protect their rights in the lawless world beyond the market. With property titles secured, they head off into the profitable, peaceful world of the market, where hard work will now be rewarded. Unfortunately, however, the evidence for the paper’s conclusions suggests that they are completely mistaken.

zh: 一种无形的平行生活
en: An Invisible Parallel Life

zh: 德·索托论点的说服力，也可以联系到埃及、秘鲁和许多其他在 1990 年代经历新自由主义经济重组计划的国家正式财产制度的危机。在开罗，稳定货币、削减政府开支、国有企业私有化和刺激私人投资的措施受到国际货币基金组织称赞，称其实现了“埃及宏观经济命运的显著好转”。
同一时期，政府和法院开始修改保护商业和住宅租户的法律，使房地产开发商摆脱租金管制的约束。
改革刺激的信贷创造主要流入房地产——投机者在那里建造大量豪华和中档住宅——以及提供移动电话通信或麦当劳餐饮等服务、供应电子产品、汽车和其他奢侈品进口的独家特许权。换言之，资本化尽可能被改道到租金来源，而不是生产性活动。制造业在经济中的份额下降，也没有为大规模增加就业作出任何重大努力。
en: The persuasiveness of de Soto’s arguments can also be connected to crises in the formal property system in Egypt, Peru, and many other countries that had experienced neoliberal economic restructuring programmes in the 1990s. In Cairo, measures to stabilise the currency, reduce government spending, privatise state-owned enterprises, and stimulate private investment had been praised by the IMF for achieving a ‘remarkable turnaround in Egypt’s macroeconomic fortunes’.
In the same period, the government and the courts began to alter the laws protecting commercial and residential tenants, freeing property developers from the constraint of rent controls.

The credit creation stimulated by the reforms flowed primarily into real estate, as speculators threw up large luxury and middle-income developments, and into exclusive concessions to provide services, such as mobile phones or McDonald’s restaurants, or supply imports of electronics, cars, and other luxury goods. In other words, capitalisation was re-routed wherever possible into sources of rent rather than into productive activity. The share of manufacturing in the economy declined, and no significant efforts were made to increase large-scale employment.

zh: 房地产投机以及奢侈品进口和服务的繁荣，到 2000 年以深度衰退告终。豪华公寓价格下跌一半以上，房地产开发商发现自己有数万套未售出公寓。
解决这些困难的办法，似乎在于自由与民主研究所的抵押贷款法提案。
en: The boom in property speculation and in luxury imports and services ended in a deep recession by the year 2000. The price of luxury apartments dropped by more than half, and property developers found themselves with tens of thousands of unsold apartments.
A solution to these difficulties seemed to lie in the ILD’s proposal for a mortgage law.

zh: 如前所述，2001 年议会通过了该法，此前自由与民主研究所及其当地合作伙伴埃及经济研究中心为经济部起草了立法草案和实施提案。
又过了两年，才设立监管新行业的机构，并成立第一家抵押贷款公司——国有住房与发展银行的子公司。该银行还与政府测量机构共同建立了一家测量和登记非正式财产的公司。
到 2005 年，只成立了两家抵押贷款公司，交易数量仍然非常有限。
拖延的原因以及未能成立更多抵押贷款公司的原因，颇能说明问题。首先是筹资问题。计划是通过在埃及股市出售证券（抵押债券）来为行业提供资本。但无论是程序还是投资者都不具备。如果德·索托的论点成立，这个障碍就说不通。产权登记和抵押贷款法本应通过释放不规范房地产的死资本来创造资金。现实中并没有死资本可以释放。相反，新抵押贷款制度试图把其他投资者拉入房地产，以拯救投机者。可用资本很少，因此改革陷入停滞。
en: In 2001, parliament passed the law, as mentioned earlier, following draft legislation and implementation proposals drawn up for the Ministry of the Economy by the ILD and its local partner, the Egyptian Center for Economic Studies.

It took a further two years to set up a body to regulate the new industry and to establish the first mortgage company, a subsidiary of the state-owned Housing and Development Bank. The Bank also established a company to survey and register informal property, co-owned with the government survey authority.
By 2005, only two mortgage companies had been established, and the number of transactions remained very limited.

The reasons for the delays and for the failure to establish additional mortgage companies are instructive. First, there was a problem in raising funds. The plan was to capitalise the industry by selling securities (mortgage bonds) on the Egyptian stock market. But neither the procedures nor the investors were available to do this. If the ILD’s arguments were valid, this obstacle would not make sense. Property titling and a mortgage law were supposed to create funds, by unlocking the dead capital of irregular real estate. In reality, there was no dead capital to unlock. Instead, the new mortgage system attempted to draw other investors into real estate, to bail out the speculators. There was little capital available, so the reforms stalled.

zh: 第二个也是更重要的障碍，以及投资者缺乏热情的一个原因，据说是担心政府不会执行赋予抵押贷款公司止赎权力的新规定。
en: The second and more important obstacle, and a reason for the lack of enthusiasm from investors, was said to be a fear that the government would not enforce new provisions giving mortgage companies the power of foreclosure.

zh: 德·索托承认，新财产制度就是要让财产所有者更没有保障。他声称，全球南方的人民仍“被困在前资本主义世界肮脏的地下室里”，不是因为他们没有财产，而是“因为他们没有财产可失去”。
如果没有驱逐违约借款人的权力，整个从死资本释放财富的项目都会失败。但殖民时期长期反对止赎权力的斗争，使任何驱逐权力都难以使用。1952 年埃及革命的主要成就之一，就是巩固了对租户权利的保护。此后数十年间，众多地方斗争强化了一种广泛的政治主张：国家不应参与使人无家可归。事实上，在 2011 年革命起义之后，埃及
新宪法明确规定了公民享有“充足、安全且健康住房”的权利。
自由与民主研究所的提案完全没有说明如何克服这一长期政治主张，也没有说明如何建立并有效实施资本化所依赖的新强制形式。
en: De Soto had acknowledged that the new property system was about making property owners less secure. People of the Global South remain ‘trapped in the grubby basement of the precapitalist world’ not because they have no property, he claimed, but ‘because they have no property to lose’.

Without the power to evict borrowers who fell into default, the entire project of releasing wealth from dead capital would fail. But a long history of struggle against the powers of foreclosure in the colonial period had made it difficult to use any powers of eviction. One of the main achievements of the 1952 revolution in Egypt had been to consolidate the protection of tenants’ rights. Numerous local struggles over the ensuing decades had reinforced a widespread political claim that the state should not be involved in making people homeless. Indeed, following the revolutionary uprisings of 2011, the new Egyptian
Constitution made explicit the right of citizens to ‘adequate, safe and healthy housing’.

Nothing in the ILD’s proposals explains how this long-standing political claim was to be overcome, or how the new forms of coercion on which capitalisation depends were to be put in place and made effective.

zh: 德·索托没有说明所涉及的力量关系，而是提供了一个简单得多的图景，描述把未登记资产变为活资本所需的程序。他把这一过程描述为再现，这个概念在他的论述中居核心地位。再现是把穷人的资产送入“市场”的操作。
en: In place of an account of the relations of forces involved, de Soto offers a much simpler picture of the procedures required to turn unregistered assets into live capital. He describes the process as one of representation, a concept that plays a central role in his account. Representation is the operation that moves the assets of the poor into ‘the market’.

zh: 如果穷人以其所说的缺陷形式持有资产，那么缺陷就在于它们不可见——也就是说，对市场不可见。德·索托解释说，在西方，财产所有权再现于一份文件中，这份文件是“一个庞大隐藏过程的可见标志，这个过程把所有这些资产与经济其余部分连接起来”。由于这一再现过程，“资产可以在与其物质存在并行的层面上，过一种无形的生活”。其他国家没有这种再现过程，这解释了为什么人们无法生产足够资产使资本主义运转。只有西方拥有解码物质资产无形蕴藏的资本所需的“转换过程”。“这就是资本的奥秘。”
en: If the poor hold their assets in defective form, the defect is that they are not visible – not visible, that is, to the market. In the West, de Soto explains, property ownership is represented in a document, which is ‘the visible sign of a vast hidden process that connects all these assets to the rest of the economy’. Thanks to this process of representation, ‘assets can lead an invisible, parallel life alongside their material existence’. Other countries do not have this representational process, and this explains why people have not been able to produce sufficient assets to make capitalism work. Only the West possesses the ‘conversion process’ needed to decode the capital that material assets invisibly harbour. ‘This is the mystery of capital.’

zh: 再现如何实现这种转换？答案是，与实物资产不同，资产的再现摆脱了物质约束，因此可以轻易移动、组合、分割，并用于创办企业。通过把资产的经济价值与其物质形式解耦，再现使资产具有可替代性。
en: How does representation achieve this conversion? The answer is that, unlike physical assets, representations of assets are set free from material restraints and therefore can be easily moved around, combined, divided, and used to launch business ventures. By uncoupling the economic value of an asset from its physical form, a representation makes the asset fungible.

zh: 首先应当指出，这种对西方再现过程的描述具有误导性。在许多西方财产制度中，包括美国和英国，并不存在德·索托所主张的那种产权文件。从历史上看，使用这类文件是被避免的，因为它可能过时，也可能被故意篡改，因而会招致欺诈。再现可能是危险之物，因为其使用并不总能受到控制。正如我下文所论证的，区分不同再现技术的不是其抽象性，而是其受控制的程度。在美国和英国，财产主张通过使用产权契据来确立。契据不是财产所有权的再现，而是对这种所有权的施行。它是一种法律文书，用来实施转移——不是
对象（财产）的转移，而是权利（所有权）的转移。要具有法律效力，它必须包含“特此”之类的词语，表明契据是一种述行性工具。这种行为还必须通过实际动作来完成，即在证人面前把文书从原所有者交给新所有者。英国和美国的产权由一系列契据累积构成，标示权利从一个所有者向下一个所有者转移的连续行为。
en: We should note, first, that this description of the process of representation in the West is misleading. In many Western property systems, including those of the United States and Britain, there was no title document of the sort that de Soto advocates. Historically, the use of such a document was avoided, because it could be outdated or might be deliberately altered and was therefore an invitation to fraud. Representations can be dangerous things, as their use cannot always be controlled. What distinguishes different techniques of representation, as I argue below, is not their abstractness but the degree of their control. In the United States and Britain, property claims were established through the use of title deeds. A deed is not a representation of property ownership, but its performance. It is a legal instrument used to perform the transfer – not

of an object (property), but of a right (ownership). To be legally valid, it had to include a term such as ‘hereby’, indicating that the deed is a performative instrument. And it had to be physically performed, by handing the instrument from the previous owner to the new owner in the presence of a witness. Property titles in Britain and the United States consisted of an accumulation of deeds, marking the successive acts of transfer of rights from one owner to the next.

zh: 即使在今天，按德·索托主张的方式引入财产登记册的尝试在美国也未成功。多数州实行私人产权保险与交易公开登记相结合的制度。这些方法往往昂贵，因为它们容易受到价格操纵以及私人利益对立法监管的俘获。但以财产登记备案——由国家记录所有财产的所有权和转移——取代这些方法的尝试并不受欢迎，因为这些程序造成长时间拖延。
en: Even today, attempts to introduce property registers in the way de Soto advocates have been unsuccessful in the United States. Most states use a system of private title insurance, combined with public registration of transactions. These methods tend to be expensive, as they are open to price fixing and the capture of legislative regulation by private interests. But attempts to replace them with property recordation, in which the state records the ownership and transfer of all property, were unpopular because of the long delays these procedures introduced.

zh: 说非正式财产制度缺乏复杂的再现系统，同样具有误导性。我们可以简要回到先前讨论的村庄。村民不断把资源投入各种资产、又从其中取出，程度相当惊人。最常见的例子是饲养家畜。几乎每户都饲养小动物（鸡、鸭、鹅、兔子和鸽子），许多人家养绵羊和山羊，超过一半拥有奶牛或水牛。
这些投资具有生产性，为餐桌提供食物，并自行繁殖。但当需要现金时，可以卖掉一只羊、一些鸡或一头牛犊。有剩余收入时，可以转化为更有保障的资产，通常是家畜（也包括以首饰形式储存的黄金）。家庭还组织轮流储蓄会，为购买炉子或水牛等大件物品筹资。卖掉一头大牲畜，可以帮助支付小本经营，例如买一台缝纫机承接裁缝活，或开一个小亭子向邻居出售香烟或日用品（糖、肥皂、灯泡）。
en: It is also misleading to suggest that informal systems of property lack complex systems of representation. We can return briefly to the village discussed earlier. It is remarkable the extent to which villagers are constantly moving resources into and out of a variety of assets. The most common instance is the raising of domestic animals. Almost every household is involved in raising small animals (chickens, ducks, geese, rabbits, and pigeons), many have sheep and goats, and more than half own a cow or a water buffalo.

These investments are productive, providing food for the table and making their own offspring. But, when a need for cash arises, a sheep, some chickens, or a calf can be sold. When surplus income arrives, it can be converted into more secure assets, typically domestic animals (but also gold, stored in the form of jewellery). Households also organise rotating credit unions to raise funds for large purchases, such as a new stove or a water buffalo. Selling a large animal can help pay for a small business venture, such as acquiring a sewing machine to take in dressmaking work or setting up a kiosk to sell cigarettes or household items (sugar, soap, light bulbs) to neighbours.

zh: 与用土地和住房作信贷抵押品相比，这类储蓄和投资有几个优点。第一，它们把储蓄引入生产性活动，而不是房地产投资。第二，它们通常由妇女掌控，而妇女比男子更可能把收入用于儿童和家庭的基本需要。第三，这些资产可以相互转换，但又不至于过于容易转换。以家畜形式持有的资源在急需时可以换成现金，但足够实在，不会在随意购物中一点点流失。
en: Such kinds of saving and investment have several advantages over using land and housing as collateral for credit. First, they draw savings into productive activity rather than real estate investment. Second, they are typically controlled by women, who are more likely than men to direct income towards the basic needs of children and the household. Third, assets are fungible, but not too fungible. Resources held in the form of domestic animals can be converted to cash when urgent needs arise but are solid enough not to drip away on casual purchases.

zh: 这些积累和流通资产的方法，与德·索托视为资本奥秘秘诀的方法有何不同？差异不在于再现的有无，也不在于其抽象程度。德·索托或许正确地指出，某些财富形式或某些再现资产的方式变得更具流动性、可以流通到更远的地方、更容易组合和积累。然而，这种流动性并非来自抽象程度，而是来自控制技术的建立，这些技术使资产能够远程、跨时间管理，并大量积累。
en: What is the difference between these methods of accumulating and circulating assets and those that de Soto sees as the secret to the mystery of capital? The difference does not lie in the presence or absence of representations, or their degree of abstraction. De Soto may be correct that certain forms of wealth, or certain ways of representing assets, become more mobile, travel further distances, and are more easily combined and accumulated. However, this mobility does not derive from the degree of abstraction. It derives from establishing techniques of control, which make it possible to manage assets at a distance and over time and accumulate them in larger quantities.

zh: 在村里，多数家庭财富以直接监管控制的资产形式持有。财富积累在家畜、屋外田地、田地另一头亲戚家旁的灌溉泵，或下一个小村落的一块土地里。这一切都相对容易管理。大地主面临大得多的监管挑战。他们雇守卫保护粮食储备，让依附于他们的家庭操作不同地产区域内的灌溉泵，依靠劳务承包商提供收割工人队。十九世纪和二十世纪初建立的更大地产，在 1952 年后被拆解，只有在监督和规训大批劳动力的方法创新之后才成为可能；这些方法基于专门建造的工人住房单元，工人夜间可以被锁在里面，受到持续监视。
最大的地产拥有“一支名副其实的雇员队伍，其唯一职业就是以最紧密、最严格的方式持续监督工人”。
监督权力，包括新法院、法警、监狱和武装警察，对于在新规模上积累财富的“再现”都至关重要。
en: In the village, most household wealth is held in assets controlled by direct supervision. The wealth is accumulated in domestic animals, the fields outside the house, an irrigation pump adjacent to a relative’s house across the fields, or a plot of land in the next hamlet. All this is relatively easy to manage. Large landowners face much greater challenges of supervision. They hire guards to protect stores of grain, use client families to operate irrigation pumps in different areas of landholding, and rely on labour contractors to supply gangs of workers for harvesting. The much larger estates built up in the nineteenth and early twentieth century, dismantled after 1952, were possible only after innovations in methods of monitoring and disciplining large labour forces, based on purpose-built worker housing units in which workers could be locked at night and kept under continuous supervision.
The largest properties possessed ‘a veritable brigade of employees whose sole occupation was to supervise the workers, continuously and in the closest and most rigorous fashion’.
The powers of supervision, including the new courts, bailiffs, prisons, and armed police forces, were all essential to the accumulation of ‘representations’ of wealth on a new scale.

zh: 如前所述，德·索托设想的财富积累，依赖于重新引入止赎和驱逐的权力，而这些权力在二十世纪面对民众抗议和经济混乱已被废止。换言之，问题不在于创造某种更抽象的东西，真要说来，反而在于某种更具物理强制性的东西——更广泛的驱逐和控制权力。尽管已有适当立法和监管机构、贷款公司和产权登记制度，抵押贷款银行的设立仍然拖延，这归根结底是因为未能获得最直接的物理强制权力。
en: The accumulation of wealth that de Soto has in mind depends, as I have noted, on the reintroduction of powers of foreclosure and eviction that were abrogated, in the face of popular protest and economic dislocation, in the course of the twentieth century. In other words, rather than a question of creating something more abstract, it is, if anything, a question of something more physical – more extensive powers of eviction and control. The delay in establishing mortgage banks, despite the appropriate legislation and regulatory body, the setting up of loan companies, and a property titling system, comes down to the failure to secure the most physical of powers.

zh: 德·索托的计划设想通过把所谓死资本转变为活资本，大规模创造财富。在实践中，证据
表明，这不会从死资本中产生活资本，而是把财富从较不富裕者转移给较有保障者，尤其是以未来穷人为代价，使当代较富裕者更加富有。
en: De Soto’s plans envisage a vast creation of wealth, by the transformation of so-called dead capital into live capital. In practice, the evidence

suggests that this will produce not live capital out of dead, but a transfer of wealth from the less affluent to the more secure, and, in particular, serve to enrich the more prosperous among the present generation at the expense of the future poor.

zh: 实现这一点的办法，不是把市场之外的东西移入市场之内，而是以新的方式部署这种边界机制。它不是通过再现目前不可见的东西来实现，而是通过改变再现的流通和管理来实现。它将通过重新安排各方力量而发生。而且它需要建立强制机制。
en: This is to be accomplished not by moving what is outside the market to the inside, but by deploying this boundary mechanism in new ways. It is not to be accomplished by representing what is currently invisible, but by altering the circulation and management of representations. It is to occur through a reorganisation of forces among a variety of parties. And it requires the creation of mechanisms of compulsion.

zh: 新自由主义经济改革方案把未被记录、受治理较少的社会经济生活形式描述为存在于经济之外；它们事实上并非之外，但也并非简单地之内。它们可以被理解为一片边疆或边界，一种既不属于市场外部也不属于市场内部的状态。它们部分在外，因为这些资产无法由市场定价，正如控制这些资产者的劳动不容易为资本主义企业所用。经济学通过生产和验证规则与程序，帮助管理这条边界，把某些生活形式划定为非正式或非市场。然而这些生活形式在某些方面又在内部，因为所谓“资本主义”或“市场”所采取的安排——例如精英借以再生产其财富的主要手段即赚取租金的方式——是与这个所谓外部长期持续互动的结果。
en: The unrecorded and less closely governed forms of socioeconomic life that are described by neoliberal economic reform programmes as lying outside the economy are not in fact outside, but nor are they simply inside. They can be understood as a frontier or border, a status that is neither exterior nor interior to the market. They are partially outside, because these assets cannot be priced by the market, just as the labour of those who control them is not easily available for capitalist enterprise. Economics helps to manage this border, by producing and validating rules and procedures that demarcate certain forms of life as informal or non-market. Yet those forms of life are, in some ways, inside, because the arrangements taken by what is called ‘capitalism’ or ‘the market’, such as the ways of earning rent that are the principal means for an elite to reproduce its wealth, are the outcome of a long and continuing interaction with this so-called outside.

zh: 德·索托的纲领——在联合国开发计划署贫困者法律赋权高级别委员会等机构推动下得到进一步推广——涉及把资产从外部移到内部。这种重新安排提供了创造财富的手段。但财富不是按德·索托论述所暗示的方法产生的。产权登记和用财产作抵押品的过程，创造了从未来投机获利、集中财富和积累租金的机会。穷人现有资产不是这种新财富的物质来源。相反，它们是包容性排除的对象。通过德·索托式的方案，它们被转变为实施这种重新安排和积累的装置。穷人仍处在这一过程“之外”，因为产权登记和财产抵押的结果是，土地和住房对穷人来说更加难以负担。他们进一步被排除在资源积累机会之外。然而，
与此同时，他们又在过程“之内”。他们的房屋和未来生活必须被改造，才能完成对未来财富的攫取。这种改造的起点是使这些生活方式成为有缺陷的、近乎死寂的，办法是按照据说它们所缺乏的经济理性和再现形式来把握它们。既然正是其缺陷性使积累成为可能，那么这就是一个所谓内部所依赖的外部。
en: De Soto’s programme, further promoted by bodies like the UNDP’s High Level Commission on Legal Empowerment of the Poor, involves the movement of assets from the outside to the inside. This reordering offers a means to create wealth. But the wealth is not produced by the method de Soto’s account implies. The process of property titling and the use of property as collateral bring into being opportunities for speculative gain from the future, for the concentrating of wealth, and for the accumulation of rents. The existing assets of the poor are not the material source of this new wealth. Rather, they are the objects of an inclusive exclusion. Through schemes such as de Soto’s, they are turned into the apparatus through which this reorganisation and accumulation is carried out. The poor remain ‘outside’ this process, for the outcome of a process of property titling and the mortgaging of property is that land and housing become even less affordable to the poor. They are further excluded from opportunities for the accumulation of resources. Yet, at

the same time, they are ‘inside’ the process. Their houses and their future lives must be transformed in order to carry out the capture of this future wealth. The starting point of this transformation is to render these ways of life defective, almost dead, by grasping them in terms of the economic rationality and forms of representation they are said to lack. Since their defectiveness is what makes the accumulation possible, it is an outside on which the so-called inside depends.

zh: 对德·索托提案的常规批评，会揭露其借以获得可信度和流行度的新自由主义谬误。它会提请注意德·索托著作所忽视的产权斗争史，以及他无法解释替代性财产安排所提供的道德主张、财务保护、实际灵活性和可负担性——无论这些安排有什么缺陷。在把他的著作贬为新自由主义正典最新通俗读本之后，人们就可以揭示他的思想作为一块薄弱挡板所掩护的真实利益。
en: A conventional critique of de Soto’s proposals would expose the neoliberal fallacies on which they rely for their plausibility and popularity. It would draw attention to the history of battles over property rights that de Soto’s writings ignore and his inability to account for the moral claims, financial protections, practical flexibility, and affordability offered, whatever their defects, by alternative property arrangements. Having dismissed his writings as no more than the latest vulgate of the neoliberal canon, one could then reveal the real interests for which his ideas are such a flimsy screen.

zh: 然而，新自由主义的工作并不在挡板背后进行。如果德·索托论点的谬误似乎出奇地容易揭露，那是因为其效力并不取决于它们对特定财产安排运作的捕捉有多精确。经济学的力量不取决于其再现准确与否。德·索托的著作是新自由主义项目装备的一部分。它们提供了一种手段，把新古典经济学的某些事实与发展机构规划、房地产开发商资源和地方政权政治权力结成联盟。它们构成一种新颖装置的一部分，用以拯救投机者、迫使穷人放弃住房、创造新的财富形式，并扩大未来的贫困化。
en: The work of neoliberalism, however, does not lie behind a screen. If the fallacies of de Soto’s arguments seem surprisingly easy to expose, that is because their effectiveness does not rest on the precision with which they capture the workings of particular property arrangements. The power of economics does not rest on the accuracy or inaccuracy of its representations. De Soto’s writings form part of the equipment for neoliberal projects. They provide a means of mobilising certain facts of neoclassical economics in alliance with the planning of development agencies, the resources of property developers, and the political powers of local regimes. They form part of the novel apparatus by which speculators are to be rescued, the poor made to give up their houses, new forms of wealth created, and the impoverishment of the future extended.
